“Double Diamond ဆိုတာဘာလဲ”

“Double Diamond ဆိုတာဘာလဲ” ဆိုပြီး မေးလာတဲ့ ကာကာလေးတွေအတွက် ရှင်းရှင်းလင်းလင်း သိသွားအောင် မင်မင်က ရှင်းပြပေးမယ်နော်။

✨Double Diamond ဆိုတာ ဘာလဲ?

အရိုးရှင်းဆုံး ပြောရရင် Double Diamond ဆိုတာက ကိုယ်ဝယ်ယူလိုက်တဲ့ Diamond ပမာဏအတိုင်း အပိုလက်ဆောင် (Bonus) အနေနဲ့ နောက်ထပ်တစ်ဆ ထပ်ရတာကို ဆိုလိုတာပါ။

ဥပမာ - ကာကာလေးတို့က Double Diamond ၁၅၀+၁၅၀ ဝယ်လိုက်တယ်ဆိုရင် ဈေးကတော့ Diamond ၁၅၀ ဈေးပါဘဲ။ ဒါပေမယ့် မူရင်း Diamond ၁၅၀ အပြင် Game ကနေ Bonus ၁၅၀ ထပ်ပေးပြီး စုစုပေါင်း Diamond ၃၀၀ ရရှိမှာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

✨Double Diamond ဘယ်နှမျိုးရှိလဲ?

MLBB ရဲ့ Shop (Recharge Section) မှာ ပုံမှန်အားဖြင့် Double Diamond ရနိုင်တဲ့ Package (၄) မျိုး ရှိပါတယ်။

50 + 50 Double Diamonds
150 + 150 Double Diamonds
250 + 250 Double Diamonds
500 + 500 Double Diamonds

✨ဘယ်လိုအချိန်မှာရမှာလဲ?

ဂိမ်းထဲက Shop ထဲက Diamond ထဲမှာ “First Recharge Bonus” ဆိုတဲ့ အနီစာတန်းလေး ပြနေမှသာ ရရှိမှာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်

✨သိထားရမယ့် “တစ်ခါစီပဲ ရမယ်” ဆိုတဲ့ စည်းကမ်း

ဒီ Double Diamond အခွင့်အရေးဟာ Package တစ်ခုကို တစ်ကြိမ်စီပဲ ခံစားခွင့်ရှိတာပါ။

ဥပမာ - 150 + 150 ကို တစ်ခါဝယ်ပြီးပြီဆိုရင် နောက်တစ်ခါ အဲဒီ package ကိုဖြည့်တဲ့အခါ Bonus Diamond ပြန်မရတော့ဘဲ ပုံမှန် Diamond 150 အတိုင်းပဲ ရတော့မှာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

ဒါပေမဲ့ ကျန်နေသေးတဲ့ 50, 250, 500 တန် Package တွေကိုတော့ Double အနေနဲ့ တစ်ခါစီ ထပ်ဝယ်လို့ ရပါသေးတယ်။

✨Event Recharge အတွက် ဘာလို့ အရေးကြီးတာလဲ?

ဂိမ်းထဲမှာ Event တွေ လာတဲ့အခါ “Recharge 250 Diamonds” ဆိုတဲ့ Task တွေကို ဖြည့်ကြရတယ်မဟုတ်လား။ အဲဒီအချိန်မှာ Double Diamond Package ကို ဝယ်လိုက်မယ်ဆိုရင် တစ်ချက်ခုတ် နှစ်ချက်ပြတ် ပါပဲ။ Event Task လည်း အောင်သလို၊ Diamond ကလည်း အပို (Bonus) ပါရမှာမို့ Draw လှည့်ဖို့အတွက် အရမ်းကို တန်တဲ့ နည်းလမ်းလေးပါ။ အဲတာမို့ Event Recharge Task တွေ ရှိတဲ့အချိန်တွေမှာ ဒီ Double Diamond Package တွေကို ဝယ်ယူတာက ပိုကောင်းပါတယ်။

“Double Diamond ဆိုတာဘာလဲ”

“Double Diamond ဆိုတာဘာလဲ” ဆိုပြီး မေးလာတဲ့ ကာကာလေးတွေအတွက် ရှင်းရှင်းလင်းလင်း သိသွားအောင် မင်မင်က ရှင်းပြပေးမယ်နော်။

✨Double Diamond ဆိုတာ ဘာလဲ?

အရိုးရှင်းဆုံး ပြောရရင် Double Diamond ဆိုတာက ကိုယ်ဝယ်ယူလိုက်တဲ့ Diamond ပမာဏအတိုင်း အပိုလက်ဆောင် (Bonus) အနေနဲ့ နောက်ထပ်တစ်ဆ ထပ်ရတာကို ဆိုလိုတာပါ။

ဥပမာ - ကာကာလေးတို့က Double Diamond ၁၅၀+၁၅၀ ဝယ်လိုက်တယ်ဆိုရင် ဈေးကတော့ Diamond ၁၅၀ ဈေးပါဘဲ။ ဒါပေမယ့် မူရင်း Diamond ၁၅၀ အပြင် Game ကနေ Bonus ၁၅၀ ထပ်ပေးပြီး စုစုပေါင်း Diamond ၃၀၀ ရရှိမှာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

✨Double Diamond ဘယ်နှမျိုးရှိလဲ?

MLBB ရဲ့ Shop (Recharge Section) မှာ ပုံမှန်အားဖြင့် Double Diamond ရနိုင်တဲ့ Package (၄) မျိုး ရှိပါတယ်။

50 + 50 Double Diamonds
150 + 150 Double Diamonds
250 + 250 Double Diamonds
500 + 500 Double Diamonds

✨ဘယ်လိုအချိန်မှာရမှာလဲ?

ဂိမ်းထဲက Shop ထဲက Diamond ထဲမှာ “First Recharge Bonus” ဆိုတဲ့ အနီစာတန်းလေး ပြနေမှသာ ရရှိမှာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်

✨သိထားရမယ့် “တစ်ခါစီပဲ ရမယ်” ဆိုတဲ့ စည်းကမ်း

ဒီ Double Diamond အခွင့်အရေးဟာ Package တစ်ခုကို တစ်ကြိမ်စီပဲ ခံစားခွင့်ရှိတာပါ။

ဥပမာ - 150 + 150 ကို တစ်ခါဝယ်ပြီးပြီဆိုရင် နောက်တစ်ခါ အဲဒီ package ကိုဖြည့်တဲ့အခါ Bonus Diamond ပြန်မရတော့ဘဲ ပုံမှန် Diamond 150 အတိုင်းပဲ ရတော့မှာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

ဒါပေမဲ့ ကျန်နေသေးတဲ့ 50, 250, 500 တန် Package တွေကိုတော့ Double အနေနဲ့ တစ်ခါစီ ထပ်ဝယ်လို့ ရပါသေးတယ်။

✨Event Recharge အတွက် ဘာလို့ အရေးကြီးတာလဲ?

ဂိမ်းထဲမှာ Event တွေ လာတဲ့အခါ “Recharge 250 Diamonds” ဆိုတဲ့ Task တွေကို ဖြည့်ကြရတယ်မဟုတ်လား။ အဲဒီအချိန်မှာ Double Diamond Package ကို ဝယ်လိုက်မယ်ဆိုရင် တစ်ချက်ခုတ် နှစ်ချက်ပြတ် ပါပဲ။ Event Task လည်း အောင်သလို၊ Diamond ကလည်း အပို (Bonus) ပါရမှာမို့ Draw လှည့်ဖို့အတွက် အရမ်းကို တန်တဲ့ နည်းလမ်းလေးပါ။ အဲတာမို့ Event Recharge Task တွေ ရှိတဲ့အချိန်တွေမှာ ဒီ Double Diamond Package တွေကို ဝယ်ယူတာက ပိုကောင်းပါတယ်။

ဒီလောက်ဆိုရင်တော့ Double Diamond အကြောင်းကို ကာကာလေးတို့ ရှင်းလင်းသွားမယ်လို့ ယူဆပါတယ်နော်။ ကိုယ့်ရဲ့ အကောင့်မှာ Double Diamond ကျန်/မကျန် သိချင်ရင်လည်း မင်မင်တို့ဆီမှာ Screenshot ပြပြီး မေးမြန်းဝယ်ယူနိုင်ပါတယ်!

Brynn Kenney je američki profesionalni poker igrač i jedna od najuspešnijih figura u istoriji turnirskog pokera, poznat po dominaciji na najskupljim high roller i super high roller turnirima.

Na vrh svetske scene dolazi postepeno, ali izuzetno sigurno, gradeći reputaciju kroz konstantne duboke plasmane i pobede na turnirima sa najvećim buy-inovima. Njegov uspon kulminira time što postaje igrač sa najvećim ukupnim turnirskim zaradama u istoriji sa preko 80 miliona dolara!

Kenney je redovan učesnik Triton serije i drugih elitnih turnira, gde se godinama takmiči protiv najjače moguće konkurencije. Njegove ukupne zarade prelaze desetine miliona dolara, a posebno se izdvaja njegova sposobnost da konstantno dolazi do finalnih stolova u najtežim fieldovima.

Poznat je po smirenom pristupu igri, mentalnoj stabilnosti i izuzetnoj disciplini u upravljanju rizikom. Njegov stil karakteriše balans između strpljenja i pravovremene agresije, što mu omogućava da maksimalno iskoristi svaku situaciju.

Kenney se nalazio u žiži raznih incidenata van poker stola, što je po mišljenju mnogih bacilo senku na njegovu karijeru, ali on bez ikakve dileme ostaje jedan od najvećih ikada.

🗻 Zilais Kalns (Blue Hill)

There are times when a person feels drained in a way that sleep does not fix. The body still works, the mind still functions, but the inner “battery” never seems to refill. Small problems feel heavier than they should. You notice impatience, irritability, or a strange emotional flatness. It may not be illness. It can be that quiet, persistent imbalance when you realize you have been running on effort for too long. In that state, you are not looking for a miracle. You are looking for a return to steadiness, for a sense that your strength is still yours and can come back.

People go to Zilais Kalns early, ideally at sunrise or in the first hours of morning, when the air is cool and the place is still quiet. The tradition centers on a spring considered healing. Locals advise approaching it slowly, letting your breathing settle after the walk. Then, without talking, you drink water in small sips. Not quickly. Not as a challenge. You pause between sips, paying attention to your body: where tension sits, where breathing feels shallow, where fatigue lives. After that, many wash their hands and face and let the water run over the wrists and neck, as if “resetting” the day. Some stand with closed eyes for a minute or two and mentally name what they want to restore: calm, resilience, clean energy, steady health. The key is to avoid bargaining and dramatic promises. The act is simple and respectful.

✍️ People often describe a quiet easing afterward. Not excitement. Not a sudden rush. More like the nervous system loosens its grip. In the days that follow, sleep may deepen, morning heaviness may lessen, the mind becomes less jumpy. You start reacting more calmly to stress because you no longer feel permanently “on edge.” 

And if the shift is subtle, there is nothing to fear. Recovery often starts as a small inner correction, not as a loud event.

⁨	چارلس پل د پراګ په زړه کې، د ولټاوه سیند پر سر پروت دی او د ښار دواړه خواوې سره نښلوي.
دا شاوخوا ۶۷۰ کاله پخوانی پل دی چې په پنځه څلوېښتو کلونو کې بشپړ شوی. اوږدوالی یې نږدې ۵۱۶ متره دی، او هر سیلانی حتمي پرې تېرېږي. خلک یې د روحونو، ارمانونو او د وعدو د پوره کېدو پل بولي.
د پُل د جوړېدو پهٔ وخت به خلکو به د شااوخوا کلیو څخه هګۍ راوړلې او له سیمنټو سره به یې ګډولې، ترڅو پل لا قوي شي. له دې وېرې چې هګۍ په لاره کې ماتې نه شي، مخکې به یې جوش کړې وې.

In the lead-up to the midterm elections, President Trump has been doubling down on his mission to end voting by mail. 

“I’m going to lead a movement to get rid of mail-ballots,” he wrote in a Truth Social post, adding that his team was drafting an executive order that would push for major changes in the American voting system. Trump’s campaign is not new. Since his 2016 presidential victory, he has questioned the legitimacy of voting by mail, going so far as to call it “massive voter fraud.” 

While many dismiss this criticism, there is widespread consensus that the U.S. voting system remains flawed, outdated and in need of reform. But significant reforms to the voting process are still miles away. One solution on the horizon seems inevitable and is already practiced in democracies overseas – one of opportunity and accessibility that includes all Americans who want their voices heard: mobile voting.

Let us know your thoughts on mobile voting in  the comments.

Self-Love: The Secret Ingredient to Stronger Relationships! 💖

Are you ready to discover the powerhouse potion that transforms your love life? 🌟 Let's talk about the magic of self-love and how it turbocharges your relationships! 

Firstly, understanding what self-love truly does is a game changer! It’s not just about bubble baths and pampering; it helps you regulate emotions, set healthy boundaries, and communicate effectively. Imagine having conversations without resorting to drama or begging for attention—just clear, calm exchanges! 

Next, let’s discuss the “reassurance trap.” Too often, we rely on our partners for emotional balance. This dependency can morph every silent moment into a mini crisis, leading to unnecessary friction. When you love yourself, you build a solid emotional foundation and alleviate that pressure. 

Speaking of boundaries: they are essential! Saying ‘no’ to negativity and disrespect isn’t selfish; it’s a protective measure for your peace and dignity. Healthy boundaries allow you to stay emotionally connected without losing your individuality. It’s love, but with a side of self-care! 

Now, let's level up your self-care game! Prioritize rest, mindfulness, and personal time. The more you nurture yourself, the more patience and love you can show to your partner. Think of it as filling your love cup so it overflows to those you cherish! 

Finally, self-love shatters the cycle of dependency. When you genuinely value yourself, you stop chasing validation. That's the shift that leads to a steadier, healthier relationship based on mutual respect and support rather than fear. 

So, are you ready to embrace self-love and watch your relationships bloom? 🌼 Share this with someone who needs a little reminder today! 💛

Today I went a birthday party for my first karate sensei, Lawrence C. McSwain. It’s difficult to summarize all of the ways that Mr. McSwain influenced my life. As a sensei, it was in the art of karate which he introduced me to. As a lawyer and judge, it was in the art of thinking honestly about life and it our participation in it. 
  I was in a room of friends, many of whom I hadn’t seen in 45 years since I left my hometown as a teenager. It was a room of legends who are the history of martial arts in North Carolina; Mr. McSwain, Vic Coffin, Bill Osterholt, and my old friend, Jay Bell, one the best fighters in the 1980’s who proved the Mike Tyson adage, that everybody has a plan until they get punched in the face. 
 
Mr. McSwain has been in the same location since the 1970’s and still charges the same price as back in my time. A genuine, altruistic human being who I’m blessed and honored to have as a friend. #zanshindojonashville #northcarolina #legends

【真壁のりびんぐ『ふらっと』で、笑顔あふれる「ふらっと」な一日】

こんにちは！移住支援コンシェルジュの尾﨑亜美です。

先日、真壁のりびんぐ『ふらっと』で開催したオープンイベント、おかげさまで最高にアットホームで幸せな時間になりました！

会場を彩ってくださったのは、Legend'sさんによるアコースティックギターの生演奏。心地よい音色に包まれて、スタートから贅沢な気分に…。

そして、思わぬ盛り上がりを見せたのが「射的」です！
大人たちが童心に帰って「本気」ではしゃぐ姿が本当に素敵でした。

お腹を満たしてくれたのは、イベントに駆けつけてくれた武村さんが振る舞ってくださった「こしあぶら」の混ぜ込みごはん。今が旬の山菜の香りが広がり、まさに春を五感で味わうひととき。あまりの美味しさに、皆さんの顔がほころんでいくのが分かりました。

さらに嬉しかったのが、ご来場いただいた皆さまからのたくさんの差し入れです。
「これ、食べてね」「お疲れ様」というお気持ちが本当に温かく、活動を支えてくださる皆さんの優しさが胸に沁みました。本当にありがとうございます…！

今回のイベントを通じて改めて感じたのは、桜川市には「人」という宝物がたくさんあるということ。

「楽しむ」という空気感の中で、移住者も地元の方も、壁を越えて「ふらっと」繋がれる。そんな場所をこれからも皆さんと一緒に育てていきたいです。

そして本日も『ふらっと』開店中です！
野菜の山ちゃんの干し芋販売しています。
是非『ふらっと』お立ち寄りください♪

Hugh Masekela 

Hugh Ramapolo Masekela was a South African trumpeter, flugelhornist, cornetist, singer and composer, widely hailed as the father of South African Jazz. A towering cultural figure, he fused Jazz with traditional African rhythms to create a sound that was both deeply rooted and boldly modern. 

Beyond his musical innovations, Masekela became a powerful voice against apartheid, writing and performing enduring protest songs such as “Soweto Blues” and “Bring Him Back Home.”

His international reach was confirmed in 1968 when his instrumental version of “Grazing in the Grass” topped the US Pop charts, making him a rare crossover success and a global ambassador for South African music.

He was born on April 4, 1939, in Emalahleni, in what was then the Union of South Africa, and died on January 23, 2018, in Johannesburg. He was 78.

Hugh Masekela, “Grazing in the Grass”: https://youtu.be/qxXZF60EPdM

Hugh Masekela 

Hugh Ramapolo Masekela était un trompettiste, bugliste, corniste, chanteur et compositeur sud-africain, largement considéré comme le père du Jazz sud-africain. Figure culturelle majeure, il a su fusionner le Jazz avec les rythmes traditionnels africains pour façonner une musique à la fois enracinée et résolument moderne. 

Au-delà de son apport artistique, Masekela s’est imposé comme une voix puissante contre l’apartheid, signant des chansons de lutte devenues emblématiques telles que “Soweto Blues” et “Bring Him Back Home”. 

Son rayonnement international s’est confirmé en 1968 lorsque sa version instrumentale de “Grazing in the Grass” a atteint la première place des classements Pop américains, faisant de lui un rare succès crossover et un ambassadeur mondial de la musique sud-africaine.

Il était né le 4 avril 1939 à Emalahleni, alors située dans l’Union d’Afrique du Sud, et s’est éteint le 23 janvier 2018 à Johannesburg. Il avait 78 ans.

Misi Sulit RRQ Hentikan Dominasi Liquid ID dan King Almighty Kevinn

Hai, MedForians!

Panggung MPL ID S17 kembali menyuguhkan drama menarik saat RRQ harus berhadapan dengan Team Liquid ID (TLID). 

Sorotan utama tertuju pada sosok Kevinn, yang kini dijuluki sebagai King Almighty Kevinn berkat performa gemilangnya yang bertransformasi dari sasaran kritik menjadi tumpuan utama tim. Banyak pihak meyakini bahwa dominasi Kevinn akan menjadi faktor utama yang memperpanjang derita kekalahan RRQ dalam pertemuan kali ini.

Di sisi lain, publik sedang menanti respons dari "Super Family" milik RRQ setelah mengalami kekalahan beruntun. Formula baru yang mengandalkan Superkenn dan Superdann sejauh ini dinilai belum tampil maksimal. Pertandingan ini juga menjadi momen refleksi bagi sejarah panjang Gold Laner RRQ, mulai dari era kejayaan Tuturu, Xinn, hingga Skylar.

Sayangnya, RRQ seakan memasuki masa kemerosotan di mana generasi penerus seperti Supertoyy dianggap belum mampu memenuhi ekspektasi besar yang ada. Kini muncul pertanyaan besar, apakah RRQ akan kembali terjebak dalam kegagalan atau justru ini saat yang tepat untuk memberikan kepercayaan penuh kepada sang rookie, Kuroky, demi memutus tren negatif mereka?

Edwin Valero improved to 25-0 with 25 KO and won the vacant WBC lightweight title with a crunching 2nd round KO of Antonio Pitalua at the Frank Erwin Center in Austin, Texas #OnThisDay in 2009.

Valero was already a controversial Venezuelan star with heavy hands, and he was known for letting his hands go. Pitalua, a puncher from Colombia, hadn't lost in several years.

As espected, Valero swung wild and appeared to lack technique at times. But when he landed, he did serious damage.

A southpaw right hand put Pitalua down in the 2nd round. He was up and quickly down again following a combination. Again Pitalua got up, and once more he was put down, and that's where the fight was mercifully ended.

"I proved one more time that I have too much power in my fists," Valero said. "I can go up to 140 pounds to fight Ricky Hatton or Manny Pacquiao, but I promise you I would knock out either of them."

In the mists of time, the Lac Viet people emerged from the sacred union of the Dragon and the Fairy. They settled between lofty mountains and the East Sea, naming their country Van Lang. But the northern neighbors also coveted this land and dispatched a massive fleet to invade the country. Regrettably, the Lac Viet fleet was heavily outnumbered. They began to lose ground in the unequal battle, appealing to the heavens for aid.

​The heavens heeded their call, and the Jade Emperor dispatched the Mother Dragon and her offspring to their aid. The dragons flew over the bay, spewing countless pearls which instantly turned into steep rocks upon touching the water. Huge rocks emerged under the ships, shattering them into splinters and creating a labyrinthine network of narrow channels which hampered the enemy's maneuvers. Nonetheless, the Lac Viets possessed intimate knowledge of the local waters and leveraged the narrow passages to navigate for a counter-attack. Thus, the hostile fleet was decimated, and a majestic bay with a cluster of towering peaks took shape in the sea. The Mother Dragon grew fond of the valiant people and decided to reside in the bay. The new home was named in her honor - Ha (Descending) Long (Dragon).

Comeback Dramatis! Alter Ego Tumbangkan EVOS Esports 2-1 di MPL ID S17

Hai, MedForians!

Dilibas dua kali oleh tim unggulan non-favorit minggu pertama, tim runner up M7 Alter Ego Esports kali ini temui lagi rintangan besar di hadapannya. Pada match ke-12 Sabtu (04/04), El Familia berhadapan dengan formasi baru EVOS Esports yang memasukkan midlaner unggulan dunia, EVOS.Pheww, dimana minggu sebelumnya mereka berhasil lolos tanpa kalah match sekalipun.

EVOS Esports sebenarnya memulai laga dengan sangat dominan pada game pertama. Kedisiplinan taktis yang dipimpin oleh Alberttt dengan Leomord dan Erlan dengan Claude berhasil mematahkan strategi agresif Freya Gold Lane milik Alter Ego. Kemenangan ronde pertama diamankan EVOS pada menit ke-16 berkat performa solid Luke yang menggunakan Sora sebagai tembok pertahanan tim.

Memasuki game kedua, meski EVOS memiliki komposisi hero yang secara teori sangat kuat untuk menangkal Assassin, Reyy dari Alter Ego memberikan kejutan besar. Menggunakan Fanny dengan mekanik kabel yang presisi, Reyy berhasil mengacak-acak formasi EVOS tanpa tumbang sekalipun. Dominasi empat Turtle dan dua Lord membawa Alter Ego menyamakan kedudukan menjadi 1-1.

Penentuan di game ketiga menjadi bukti kejeniusan adaptasi Alter Ego oleh Coach Xepher. Mereka mengubah gaya permainan menjadi lebih defensif dan berkelanjutan dengan kombinasi Zhuxin serta Baxia. Momen penculikan krusial oleh alekk dan Hijumee pada menit ke-17 menjadi titik balik yang memberikan ruang bagi Arfy untuk menghancurkan pangkalan EVOS, dengan melakukan Double Savage bersejarah pada turnamen tersebut.

Kemenangan 2-1 ini membuktikan bahwa kemampuan adaptasi taktik di tengah pertandingan menjadi kunci utama Alter Ego dalam mengamankan poin penting di fase reguler musim ini.

Bagaimana tanggapan MedForians mengenai Double Savage dalam satu game ketiga oleh AE.Arfy pada match ini?

Kini, beban besar untuk membawa perubahan nyata tertuju sepenuhnya kepada Reyy dalam laga melawan Navi. Supporting penyfandan on the last climb of his year long challenge raising money and awareness of @bowelcanceruk in memory of his wife Rita. The man is a legend, a gentleman and a scholar. 

Conditions were awful (again) and wanted to be at the top by the time he got there to cheer him, as I’m not fast (understatement) so left a bit earlier. 

Only the 5th time I’ve don’t it, on 3 occasions in the last 7 months and got my kit wrong, so didn’t hang around at top very long. Wet and cold legs and hands. 

Didn’t anticipate the rain 🤦‍♀️ so no base layer under my tracksuit bottoms that were not waterproof… gloves were useless at the top of the ridge and couldn’t withstand the wet. And spare pair in the bloody car. 

We ask ourselves why people do these challenges; there was a small group of men carrying a huge log up and down for mental health; Chris has smashed the record by more than doubling amount of climbs in a year, and it’s clear that what starts out as a physical challenge becomes a mental one. And no amount of pain is harder than the pain of losing a loved one or seeing them in pain. 

So as the guys said, live for now, don’t let anyone say you can’t, and love your people hard as time is a precious commodity 

And check yourself of course… and be sensible on the mountain. Never underestimate it… 

Now enjoy your easter chocolate Chris, you’ve earned it

These legends were not made to feel pretty. They were made to feel close, cold, and wrong. That is why dark English folklore still pulls people in, because it feels like something is hiding just beyond the trees. 🌒

Happy 52nd Birthday to "The Tiger" Vassiliy Jirov, 1990s and 2000s cruiserweight champion, who was born Vassiliy Valereyevich Jirov in Balqash, Kazakhstan #OnThisDay in 1974.

Jirov was a hard-hitting and relentless southpaw who was also an Olympic gold medalist and won the Val Barker Trophy at the Games, where he avenged an old loss to Antonio Tarver. He was a strong cruiserweight during a turbulent time for the division, and he moved up to heavyweight toward the end of his career.

Following a 12-year career, Jirov retired with a record of 38-3-1 and 32 KO.

Ernie Terrell, 1960s WBA heavyweight champion, was born in Belzoni, Mississippi #OnThisDay in 1935.

Terrell was also a two-time Golden Gloves champion and the brother of singer Jean Terrell. He was a good boxer-puncher who threw a high-level jab, and while he was tall and rangy, he wasn't a particularly heavy fighter. Nevertheless, Terrell defeated the likes of Zora Folley, Eddie Machen, George Chuvalo, Bob Foster and many others.

After a 16-year career, Terrell retired at 46-9 with 21 KO.

👑 Echoes of Greatness — When Legends Walk Among Us

Legends don’t vanish—they return in new names, new faces, and new stories.

🪶 Meaning: “Today’s heroes are yesterday’s demigods reborn”
This statement suggests that the figures we admire in the present—leaders, artists, activists, innovators—are modern reflections of the legendary demigods and mythic heroes of the past.

🔍 Deeper Insight
Continuity of human ideals: In ancient myths, demigods stood for courage, strength, sacrifice, and destiny. Today’s heroes embody those same qualities, just in real-world contexts.

Myth becomes reality: What used to be told as supernatural stories is now expressed through human achievement—science, leadership, art, and resilience.

Rebirth of archetypes: The “demigod” is not literally reborn, but the archetype—the pattern of greatness—reappears in new people across generations.

🌍 In Simple Terms
The heroes we celebrate today are like modern versions of the legendary figures people once worshipped in myths—they carry the same spirit, just in a different time.

✨ What It Implies
We still need symbols of hope and strength.
Greatness never disappears—it evolves.
Every generation creates its own “myths” through real people.

🌟 Takeaway
The line reminds us that heroism is timeless. The stage changes, the names change—but the essence of greatness remains.

Formula Juara Team Liquid ID Kembali, Akankah Dewa United Beri Pelajaran?

Hai, MedForians!

Pertarungan antar kuda hitam akan tersaji saat Team Liquid ID (TLID) berhadapan dengan Dewa United Esports. TLID secara mengejutkan memulai pekan pertama dengan hasil sempurna lewat dua kemenangan beruntun meski tampil dengan susunan pemain yang tergolong baru. Narasi mengenai kembalinya formula juara lama tampaknya mulai bekerja bagi TLID, membuat mereka terlihat sangat siap mengejutkan siapa pun lawan di depannya.

Fokus utama pada pertandingan ini tertuju kepada sang jungler, "King Maharaja Kevinn", yang performanya sedang melesat tajam. Berdasarkan data statistik, Kevinn memimpin sebagai jungler dengan rata-rata assist terbanyak (7.6) dan rata-rata damage taken tertinggi (108,612). Selain itu, ia juga menempati peringkat kedua dalam rata-rata gold serta peringkat ketiga untuk rata-rata damage, sebuah catatan yang sangat impresif bagi seorang pemain yang awalnya sempat menerima banyak kritik.

Mampukah TLID melanjutkan perjalanan ajaib mereka dengan formula juaranya? Atau justru Dewa United yang akan memberikan realita pahit kepada Aran dan para rookie barunya?. Jangan lewatkan duel pembuktian konsistensi ini!

Bernard "The Executioner" Hopkins avenged an old loss with a 12 round unanimous decision over 41-year-old Roy Jones, Jr. at the Mandalay Bay Resort & Casino in Las Vegas, Nevada #OnThisDay in 2010.

Though it was a victory and Hopkins dominated this rematch, he simply had much more remaining in his tank than his rival despite being older.

Hopkins landed a right hand that staggered and cut Jones in the 2nd round. Hopkins then went on to claim a series of fouls in the 4th, 8th and 10th rounds, with most appearing borderline shots at worst, and completely fabricated for others, which the crowd wasn't happy about.

Jones was nevertheless clearly a husk of his old self, and Hopkins was still a serious fighter, though one whose offense had dropped off. Hopkins took a clear decision.

“It was definitely worth it,” Hopkins said. “It was sweet revenge. It was kind of rough in there. He’s a good fighter, he tried to rough me up. I tried to tough it out, but I was seeing stars from the sixth round on. My head is still killing me. Maybe because I got hit over the head, they might think I’m crazy, but I want David Haye for the heavyweight championship of the world.”

Cameron Park is one of Texas’ largest municipal parks. Along with being a beautiful place full of amazing views of the Texas landscape, the park contains many stories. I believe that one of the reasons we have legend and folklore is to help us understand accidents and death. Either the spirits of the dead linger as ghosts or they sometimes linger as stories that are retold over and over again. 
One such story is Cameron Park’s Lovers Leap. Lovers Leap is a cliff area in the park. It is one of the most popular attractions because of the spectacular views. A legend is told about the spot that is reminiscent of Juliet and her Romeo. A Native American, who was the daughter of the chief named
 Wah-Wah-Tee had fallen in love with a brave from an enemy tribe. They were going to run away together, but instead Wah-Wah-Tee’s family intervened and caught them on the cliff area. Just like Romeo and Juliet, the two would rather face death than a lifetime apart, so they embraced and leapt off the cliff into the river. 
There’s no historical evidence for the tale. To be honest, there are many cliff areas all over the world that have a similar legend attached to them. However, the one thing in common is that all these areas are places where a misstep could lead to a disastrous, fatal fall. 
I believe the Lovers Leap stories help us to romanticize the fact that these places are often the site of fatal falls. Waco’s Lovers Leap has been a safety concern and park authorities have constructed barriers to keep the public from the cliff edge to prevent any accidental falls.
Maybe the spirit of Wah-Wah-Tee and her lover aren’t there, but maybe when you visit the site, you’ll feel the spirit of those who walked a little too close to the cliff’s edge.

🇪🇸El Kitsune es un espíritu del folclore japonés representado como un zorro de inteligencia superior y poderes mágicos que crecen con la edad. Famoso por su capacidad de cambiar de forma y por sus múltiples colas —hasta un máximo de nueve—, simboliza sabiduría y longevidad. Se dividen principalmente entre los mensajeros sagrados de la deidad Inari, que traen protección, y los espíritus traviesos llamados Yako. Al obtener su novena cola, su pelaje se vuelve blanco o dorado y adquiere la omnisciencia, elevándose a un estado prácticamente divino.

🇬🇧🇺🇸In Japanese mythology, the Kitsune is a forest spirit depicted as a fox with superior intelligence and vast magical powers that grow as it ages. These beings are primarily known for their shapeshifting abilities, often transforming into women or the elderly to interact with humans, and for possessing multiple tails—up to a maximum of nine—which symbolize their level of wisdom and power. Upon attaining its ninth tail, a Kitsune’s fur turns golden or white, and it gains the ability to see and hear everything happening in the world, becoming a virtually divine and omniscient being that transcends the boundaries of animal nature.

Marlon Brando : The Original Rock‘n’Roll Rebel

Dans le film The Wild One (L’Équipée Sauvage, 1953) de László Benedek, Johnny Strabler chef des Black Rebels Motorcycle Club (BRMC)  incarné par Marlon Brando a posé certains codes vestimentaires et comportementaux du Rock : Perfecto Schott (de préférence), Levi’s 501 Big E, et la Rébellion comme mode de vie. 

Sans avoir jamais été une Rock Star au sens musical du terme, Marlon Brando, tout comme James Dean incarnant l’adolescent révolté Jim Stark dans Rebel Without a Cause (La Fureur de vivre, 1955) de Nicholas Ray, ont préparé les esprits à l’avènement de ce vaste mouvement populaire qui a transformé durablement la société. 

Dès 1957, le philosophe et sociologue français Edgar Morin avait saisi cette profonde mutation sociétale dans son livre « Les Stars » qui sacrait l’émancipation de la jeunesse par le cinéma et le Rock’n’Roll🤘🏽!

L’acteur aux deux Oscars (On the Waterfront et The Godfather) dont le dernier refusé (vous avez dit rebelle ?!) aurait eu 101 ans ce jour.

Ce rebelle avait plusieurs causes à son arc !

Marlon Brando: The Original Rock‘n’Roll Rebel

In The Wild One (1953), directed by László Benedek, Marlon Brando’s portrayal of Johnny Strabler, leader of the Black Rebels Motorcycle Club (BRMC), set the tone for Rock‘n’Roll attitude—both in style and spirit. The Perfecto Schott leather jacket (a must), Levi’s 501 Big E jeans, and rebellion as a way of life became cultural hallmarks.

Though never a Rock star in the musical sense, Brando—like James Dean as Jim Stark in Rebel Without a Cause (1955)—helped pave the way for a youth movement that would permanently reshape society.

By 1957, French philosopher and sociologist Edgar Morin had already identified this societal shift in his book Les Stars, recognizing cinema and Rock‘n’Roll as catalysts for youth emancipation.

The two-time Oscar winner (On the Waterfront, The Godfather)—who famously refused his second award (rebellious to the end, wasn’t he?)—would have turned 101 today.

This rebel had more than one cause to fight for.

David Haye ground down John Ruiz while making his first defense of the WBA heavyweight title with a rough 9th round TKO at the M.E.N. Arena in Manchester, England #OnThisDay in 2010.

Ruiz's night nearly ended much earlier as he was sent down twice in the opening round, but he ended up absorbing a number of rabbit punches during the round. Haye deservedly lost a point for the rabbit punching.

Haye then physically ground Ruiz down and strong-armed him, making the fight rough for the 38-year-old former champ, whose legs weren't u[ for a tough inside fight. Ruiz went down again in round 5, and once more in the 6th. From that point forward he followed Haye around looking for a right hand that never appeared.

In the 9th round, Haye caught Ruiz with a series of punches that made Ruiz's corner throw in the towel.

“I am really happy,” Haye said. “I felt I was really sharp. There were a load of fans here. The crowd has been absolutely electric for me. There was a 20,000 capacity here with everyone screaming the ‘Hayemaker.’ With performances like that I’ll keep the fans behind me.”

🪨 Cholpon-Ata Petroglyphs (Rock Garden)

Sometimes you need support that is not emotional, not social, not dependent on anyone’s approval. Something older and steadier. The petroglyph field near Cholpon-Ata gives exactly that kind of grounding. Stones scattered under open sky carry carved figures and symbols that survived countless seasons. People come here when they feel unrooted, when confidence is thin, or when they want to reconnect with a deeper sense of continuity.

The best way to enter this place is early morning, when there are few visitors and the stones feel undisturbed. Walk slowly between them and do not try to “understand” everything. Let your attention choose for you. One stone will pull your gaze first. Stop there. Sit or stand in front of it and ask one quiet question: what strength is already in me, but I keep postponing it? Then look again at the lines on the stone. Often, something simple rises to the surface: a forgotten skill, a long-delayed decision, a truth you already know.

People often leave Cholpon-Ata with an unusual steadiness. The mind stops racing, and actions feel more straightforward. If you cannot explain what changed, there is nothing to fear. Not every transformation arrives as a sentence. Sometimes it arrives as posture: you stand a little straighter, and that is the whole message.

📍 Kyrgyzstan, Cholpon-Ata, north shore of Issyk-Kul
🧭 Coordinates: 42.6578° N, 77.0564° E

Freddie Miller, 1930s featherweight champion, was born Frederick M. Mueller in Cincinnati, Ohio #OnThisDay in 1911.

Miller is widely recognized as the first southpaw featherweight champ, and he had an incredible chin, having been stopped twice in more than 250 pro fights, with each coming in his first and last pro fights. He both faced and defeated a who's who of featherweights from his time.

After a 13-year career, Miller retired at 185-29-5 with 45 KO.

💔 Pause to Reflect: Why Time Apart Fuels Relationship Growth! 🚀 

Ever felt like your arguments go in circles, leaving you both more confused and hurt than before? 🤯 Here’s the secret: a little time apart can do wonders for clarity! 

When tempers flare and emotions run high, forcing answers can lead to miscommunication. Taking a brief break allows both partners to cool down and return with clearer minds and more meaningful dialogue. ✌️ 

And guess what? Silence doesn’t always mean rejection! 🤐 Sometimes, it’s simply a cue that one partner needs space to process their thoughts. Allowing this time can foster understanding instead of panic. 

Have you ever found yourself stuck in endless loops of the same argument? 😩 Rather than exhausting yourselves, stepping back can reset your perspectives. A little time apart can clear the air and help you return to the discussion with fresh insight! 

Remember, not every dispute has an instant fix. ⏳ Trust issues and old wounds require patience. Taking a pause permits each person to reflect and gather their thoughts for a more constructive conversation later. 

But let’s get this straight: using distance as a punishment is a no-go! 🚫 The aim of time apart should always be for emotional clarity, not revenge. Make it clear when and how you’ll reconnect! 

Lastly, don’t leave your partner guessing. 🙅‍♂️ Set a concrete return time like “Let’s chat tonight.” This simple gesture helps alleviate anxiety and ensures that both partners feel connected, even in silence. 

Next time conflict arises, remember the power of a little time apart! 💖✨

Era Baru Bigetron by Vitality, Mampukah Geek Fam Menahan Gempuran Sang Raja?

Hai, MedForians!

Pertarungan sengit antara Geek Fam ID melawan Bigetron by Vitality (BTR) pada Week 2 MPL ID S17 menjadi sorotan utama, tepatnya di match ke-11 yang digelar Sabtu ini (04/04).

Kedua tim saat ini tengah berada dalam fase krusial untuk menemukan formula kemenangan yang paling tepat demi mengamankan posisi mereka.

Geek Fam menunjukkan sinyal positif dengan peningkatan performa setelah kedatangan pemain baru asal Malaysia, Ye3. Meski peningkatan tersebut belum cukup untuk menahan dominasi ONIC pada laga sebelumnya, kehadiran Ye3 memberikan harapan baru bagi strategi tim. Di sisi lain, BTR melakukan langkah berani dengan merombak susunan pemain demi memberikan jam terbang bagi trio MDL mereka.

Menariknya, musim ini BTR tidak hanya mengejar gelar "Raja Musim Reguler" yang sudah melekat sejak Season 5. Coach Theonnael mengungkapkan bahwa fokus utama tim kali ini adalah persiapan matang menuju babak playoff untuk memutus rantai kegagalan yang selalu menghantui mereka di fase tersebut. Strategi memberikan pengalaman kepada pemain muda diharapkan mampu membangun mentalitas kuat saat menghadapi tantangan yang lebih besar.

Apakah Geek Fam mampu memberikan kejutan dengan kekompakan barunya? Atau justru eksperimen pemain muda BTR yang akan kembali menguasai panggung? Mari kita saksikan pembuktian mereka di MPL ID S17!

Lightweight champ Beau Jack defeated fellow great Henry Armstring by disputed 10 round unanimous decision in a non-title bout at Madison Square Garden in New York #OnThisDay in 1943.

About 20,000 fans attended at The Garden and watched a pair of excellent technicians trade leather. Jack attempted to time Armstrong as the former champion predictably came forward, while the crowd continually favored Armstrong's all-action style.

They traded rounds back and forth until Jack appeared to rock Armstrong in the 4th and 5th. Toward the end of the 5th, Armstrong stunned Jack and send him to his corner groggy. Jack roared back before Armstrong staged a furious rally in rounds 8, 9 and 10 that won the crowd over.

"The decision was booed long and loudly," wrote the New York Daily News.

"I was disappointed," Armstrong said. "Not alone by the decision, which I thought should have been at least a draw, but I was also disappointed in Jack. They told me he fought like I did; but I was never a 'runaway' fighter like he was tonight, was I?"

⛰️Santash: Where stones heal the fear of time

Sometimes the fear is not of events, but of time itself — the sense that years are passing faster than meaning accumulates. Santash Pass, known in legend as the “Stone Count,” offers a different way of measuring life. Here, stones are said to mark not years, but moments of endurance.

Visitors usually pick up one stone at the base and carry it uphill. Along the way, they recall three moments when life was difficult but survivable. At the top, the stone is placed with the others, and one simple phrase is acknowledged internally: “I count experience, not years.” This shift often changes how the past is viewed — from loss to proof of resilience.

After Santash, many feel a quiet respect for themselves. Not pride, but recognition. And if a soft sadness accompanies this feeling, there is nothing to fear. Sometimes sadness simply means you have finally accepted your life as it truly is.

Aaron "The Hawk" Pryor returned from his first win over rival Alexis Argüello by defending the WBA junior welterweight title with a 3rd round TKO of Kim Sang Hyun at the Sands Casino Hotel in Atlantic City, New Jersey #OnThisDay in 1983.

The fight almost didn't happen after reports of Pryor's managerial and health issues, which he said were caused by stress. He'd also gotten into trouble several times by this point, however. 

The fight ultimately happened and Pryor delivered with a dominant performance.

A ringside report said:

"Pryor went on the attack from the outset of the first round against Kim, pinning the 28-year-old challenger on the ropes as he lashed out with combinations to the body. Pryor stayed on the offensive in the second round, working on his southpaw opponent's head with left hooks and stinging rights.

Pryor landed a barrage of unanswered punches in the third round before Referee Carlos Benocal of Panama stepped in to stop it. It was Pryor's seventh title defense since he won the crown from Antonio Cervantes in August 1980."

"I just outclassed him," Pryor said. "I outboxed him."

Deep in the archives of the Canalave Library, you will find countless ancient scrolls and tomes which detail the many legends of the Sinnoh region. 

The first ancient book that you pick up is titled, "The Creator" by @garuru_cards It describes an omnipotent being born from a chaotic void, the all-powerful Arceus, who seeks to build a world in his image and fill it with life. 

The next text you find is titled, "Luster Pearl" by @master_hoothoot This passage describes a master of space, capable of changing the very laws of physics as we know them. The dimensional dwelling pearlescent dragon, Palkia! 

You then uncover a scroll titled, "Tempus Fugit" by @buddy_ringo As you read onward, you get the sense that the world around you comes to a stop, and you get lost in the story of the diamond-clad master of time, Dialga.

As you continue your quest for knowledge you stumble upon a tome titled, "Matter of Time" by @pokeboyyz Continuing the story of Dialga, you learn that this Pokemon has a long-standing feud with its rival Palkia, causing their worshippers to feud as well! 

Curiosity pushes you deeper, and you come across a memoir titled, "Lunar Dreamer" by @bubblemegx which details a young woman's chance encounter with Lunala, who visited her in her dreams to ward off nightmares caused by the malevolent Darkrai. 

And just when you think you've read them all, a book appears on the table in the middle of the room titled, "The Distorted Demon" by @dillon_collects which speaks of a master of antimatter whon was banished to the Distortion World, Giratina!

We hope you enjoyed this brief dive into some of favorite Sinnoh myths and legends! We would love to hear your favorite Gen 4 legendary, and we hope you all have a great Thursday friends! 😊🙏

It’s always an absolute joy to work on @tinaturner projects, and writing the liner notes for this 30th-anniversary reissue of her ‘Wildest Dreams’ album was no exception. 

Through all-new interviews with producer @trevorhornmusic; Tina’s most trusted songwriter, Holly Knight (‘The Best’, ‘One of the Living’, ‘In Your Wildest Dreams’); and a rare chat with the singer’s long-term manager, Roger Davies – plus archival quotes from Tina herself – this is probably the deepest look yet at a remarkable moment in Tina’s career. 

Expect the ‘GoldenEye’ comeback, a live show that made Tina the first female artist to gross $100 million on one tour, and an artist redefining what was expected of a female singer five decades into her career. 

“It was something in her soul and her energy,” Holly told me. “I think she’s out there now, boomeranging around in the light and having a blast.”

This is truly force-of-nature stuff, as the 4CD/Blu-ray deluxe edition makes clear.

Pre-order it here: https://tinaturner.lnk.to/WD30

‼️- Sociale huurwoningen Legends vandaag op DĀK -
Vandaag (donderdag 2 april) om 18.00 uur worden de sociale huurwoningen van het nieuwbouwcomplex Legends op DĀK (voorheen Woningnet) aangemeld. Het project 'Legends' is gelegen aan het Berlijnplein aan de oostzijde van het winkelcentrum Leidsche Rijn in Utrecht. 

Legends bestaat uit 49 sociale huurwoningen, 52 midden huurwoningen en 51 vrijesector huurwoningen met een gezamenlijke binnentuin en inpandige parkeerkelder. Het gebouw wordt 8 woonlagen hoog. In dit complex komen 49 sociale huurwoningen van Bo-Ex. 
👉Deze woningen worden met voorrang verhuurd aan bewoners van 55+. De woningen bestaan uit 1 of 2 kamers, waarbij de woonoppervlakte varieert van 34 tot 65 vierkante meter.

Geïnteresseerd? Reageer dan op DĀK (voorheen Woningnet)-> utrecht.mijndak.nl/
Let op: u kunt reageren tot en met donderdag 9 april!

Kijk voor meer informatie op boex.nl/nieuws/sociale-huurwoningen-complex-legends-vandaag-op-dak

Hai, MedForians!

Dewa United Esports benar-benar menunjukkan kelasnya pada pekan kedua MPL ID S17. Dalam laga Match 9 melawan NAVI, tim berlogo Anak Dewa ini berhasil meraih kemenangan mutlak 2-0 berkat kedisiplinan makro dan pemahaman hero interaction yang sangat matang. Bukan hanya soal adu mekanik, kemenangan ini adalah hasil dari analisis taktis yang cerdas dalam merespons draf lawan.

Pada gim pertama, Dewa United sukses meredam regenerasi Uranus milik Karss dengan kompilasi item anti-heal dan pasif Baxia. Meski Karss mampu menyerap damage hingga 209 ribu, pertahanan NAVI tetap runtuh karena pemotongan regen yang signifikan. Octa yang tampil gemilang menggunakan Zetian dinobatkan sebagai MVP dengan partisipasi eliminasi mencapai 92% tanpa tumbang sekalipun.

Masuk ke gim kedua, meski NAVI mencoba melakukan hard counter terhadap Freya dengan Esmeralda, Dewa United meresponsnya dengan "Bodyguard Formation". Muezza yang menggunakan Gloo tampil sebagai pilar utama dengan menyerap 164.151 damage, memberikan ruang bebas bagi rekan setimnya untuk melakukan penyelesaian akhir. Kemenangan bersih ini membuktikan bahwa adaptasi strategi di tengah pertandingan adalah kunci utama Dewa United untuk mengamankan poin penuh.

🏞️Book Review🏞️

Book:- The Whispering Mountains: Poems Of Uttarakhand's Legends And Folktales
Author:-@shweta_k_kapoor 

“Where the mountains don’t just stand tall—they speak, remember, and sing.”

Shweta Kapoor’s The Whispering Mountains: Poems of Uttarakhand’s Legends and Folktales is less a conventional poetry collection and more a quiet, immersive journey into a living landscape. It doesn’t rush to impress—it unfolds, like mist lifting slowly off a Himalayan valley.

The book is an attempt to translate oral tradition into lyrical form, and for the most part, it succeeds with sincerity. Kapoor leans into the cadence of storytelling rather than overly ornate poetry, which makes the collection accessible even to readers who don’t usually gravitate toward verse.

The language is simple but intentional—there’s a conscious effort to let the stories breathe instead of overpowering them with stylistic excess.

You can feel the presence of Uttarakhand—not just as a setting, but almost as a character. The mountains, rivers, and forests aren’t passive backdrops; they carry memory, emotion, and a sense of quiet mysticism. There’s a recurring stillness in these poems that feels authentic to the region’s spiritual and cultural identity.

The collection lands in a gentle, reflective space. It doesn’t aim to overwhelm but to linger. Some poems will stay with you not because they dazzle, but because they feel like echoes of something older and deeper—stories you’ve somehow heard before, even if you haven’t.

Overall, The Whispering Mountains is a thoughtful, heartfelt anthology that will appeal most to readers who appreciate culture, folklore, and place-driven writing. It may not push the boundaries of poetry as a form, but it offers something equally valuable—a bridge between past and present, told in a voice that is calm, grounded, and genuine.

📣 New Home for Performing Lines NSW 🎉

We’re excited to share a new chapter for Performing Lines NSW. After more than 30 years at our home on the corner of Chalmers and Redfern Streets in Redfern, the Warrane/Sydney team is moving just across the suburb to a new home at Carriageworks @carriageworks .

Last night, we gathered to farewell our Chalmers Street home and celebrate the many artists, collaborators, friends and communities who have filled it with life over the years. 💛 Swipe to see the lovely faces — a special moment with our PL legends Wendy Blacklock and Bill Harris in the house!

Set up in the 90s by Performing Lines founder and patron Wendy Blacklock, the Chalmers St office was home to generations of staff members producing and touring works by artists including William Yang, DanceNorth, Force Majeure, Branch Nebula, erth Visual & Physical, and many more.

As we step into this next chapter, we carry this legacy forward and look to the future in our new home, continuing to support, produce and nurture artists across NSW and all of Australia. ✨

Knowth —2025/03/19— 📍Brú na Bóinne, near Drogheda, County #Meath, #Ireland

🗺️
Located within the #Boyne Valley complex of Brú na Bóinne, overlooking a bend of the River Boyne. The site forms part of a dense #prehistoric ceremonial landscape alongside nearby #monuments

🏛️
Constructed during the #Neolithic, representing one of the most complex passage tomb #Tumulus sites in Ireland, built by early farming communities within a highly organized #ritual landscape

🗿
#Barrows Complex
Large central #Cairn 

⏳
3200 BC

📏
Main mound diameter: 67 m
Height: 12 m

⚖️
Largest kerbstones: 10–20 tonnes

⚒️
Local Greywacke and other stones collected from the Boyne Valley

🧱
Massive circular Cairn under a barrow, encircled by 127 kerbstones, many decorated with intricate #carvings
Two long passages placed back-to-back, leading to separate chambers — a unique configuration in Ireland
Around the main mound are 17 smaller satellite mounds

✔️
Extensively excavated and restored between 1962–2000 

🧭
Passages are oriented roughly east & west, possibly aligned with #equinox sunrise & sunset

🔥
Funerary monument & major #ceremonial centre within the Brú na Bóinne complex

🔄
Evidence of reuse & activity extending into later prehistoric & early #historic periods

🏺
Excavations revealed cremated & unburnt human remains, along with decorated stones & artefacts

🗡️
Knowth is part of a #mythological landscape associated with #ancient #Irish #legends, sometimes linked to the #TuathaDeDanann, who were said to inhabit great mounds beneath the earth

❓
May have functioned as a #cosmological structure
Possibly marking solar events
Structuring ritual movement 

⭐
Contains the largest collection of #megalithic art in Europe, with over 200 decorated stones

📜

🚶
Accessible via #GuidedTours from the Brú na Bóinne visitor centre

With the rise of control mages in the current meta, Zhuxin stands out as a powerful battlefield manipulator who excels at controlling enemy positioning.

📍: Overview
Strengths: Strong crowd control, excellent zoning, sustained AoE damage, strong teamfight presence, good mobility during fights

⚙️ Recommended Build
• Warrior/Tough Boots– Choose based on enemy team composition for early defense and survivability
• Clock of Destiny – Scales well into mid and late game for extra HP and magic power
• Glowing Wand – Consistent burn damage during extended fights
• Wishing Lantern – Provides cooldown reduction, mana sustain, and consistent magic damage
• Ice Queen Wand – Extra slow effects that synergize well with her continuous damage skills
• Blood Wings – Late-game survivability and massive magic power boost

🧬 Emblem & Spell
Emblem: Common Emblem
• Agility → Extra movement speed for better positioning and rotations
• Wilderness Blessing → Increased movement speed when moving through jungle and river areas
• Brave Smite → Restores HP after hitting enemies with skills, improving survivability in fights

Battle Spell: Flicker – Helps reposition for better lantern control or escape dangerous dives

🔁 Combo (Enemy Displacement Control)
Skill 1 → Skill 2 (Hold and stack) → Release Skill 2 to throw enemies → Ultimate → Skill 1 follow-up

💡 Tips
• Use Skill 1 to slow enemies and apply Soul Snare stacks before controlling them with Skill 2
• Hold Skill 2 to continuously damage enemies and build stacks that eventually capture them and pull them airborne
• Release Skill 2 carefully to throw captured enemies toward your team or into dangerous positions
• Use your Ultimate to blink into fights and apply constant pressure while stacking Soul Snare on multiple enemies
• Proper mana management is important because her lantern ability consumes mana while channeling

⚠️ Counters
• Hayabusa – Can quickly burst Zhuxin before she sets up her control
• Diggie – Removes crowd control effects and negates her displacement setups
• Chou – Strong pick-off potential and can interrupt her positioning control

Perang Kuda Hitam: Misi NAVI Hentikan Dominasi Dewa United Esports

Hai, MedForians!

Pekan kedua MPL Indonesia Season 17 dibuka dengan pertarungan sengit antara dua tim yang siap membuktikan diri sebagai kuda hitam sejati. 

Dewa United Esports akan berhadapan dengan NAVI dalam laga yang penuh gengsi dan sejarah rivalitas yang timpang.

Dewa United datang dengan rasa percaya diri tinggi berkat rekam jejak historis yang dominan. Hingga saat ini, NAVI tercatat belum pernah merasakan satu pun kemenangan atas Dewa. Kekuatan utama Dewa musim ini terletak pada amunisi baru mereka di posisi jungler, Dolynn. Sang juara MDL S13 ini tampil memukau pada laga debutnya dengan mekanik yang tajam serta ketenangan yang luar biasa. Selain itu, kehadiran Kayn sebagai opsi jungler baru juga patut dinantikan apakah ia akan melakoni debutnya pekan ini.

Di sisi lain, NAVI membawa ambisi besar untuk memecahkan kutukan tersebut. Di bawah arahan Ynot, pelatih jenius dengan gelar juara M Series, NAVI menunjukkan gaya bermain yang sangat agresif dan fleksibilitas draft hero yang sulit ditebak. Meski sering kali menyia-nyiakan keunggulan di awal laga, NAVI tetap menjadi ancaman serius. For Game Worn Wednesday I’m back with a MASSIVE recent PC Pickup. This is a 2016 Panini Preferred Game Used “Chargers” 8 player (Philip Rivers, Keenan Allen, Malcom Floyd, Steve Johnson, Antonio Gates, Manti Te’o, Melvin Ingram, & Jahlil Addae) Booklet /25. I rescued this card all the way from Canada off eBay, and safe to say this is one that’s found its forever home. This is a card truly made for a Chargers collector like myself, and I’m so thrilled to own it. There aren’t many cards in general with 8 game used pieces of jersey, let alone all of them being members of my favorite team. It’s as if this card was made for me. I had my eyes on an /49 version of this card for awhile, but didn’t pull the trigger on it due to it being priced high. I ended up getting this one that’s lower numbered with better patches for less out the door than it would’ve been pre taxes and shipping for the /49 one. Every single patch on the other one was single colored, where as all of them on this one are multicolored with some having 3/4 colors. Safe to say I got a hell of a deal on this one. The Melvin Ingram patch also appears to be a part of the Chargers wordmark logo on the jersey, which adds another layer of intrigue to this card. Jahlil Addae also does not have many cards at all, and even fewer game used patch cards so it’s nice to finally have a card with him on it in the collection. I love booklets and I’m so happy to have one of the greatest Chargers booklets ever created added to the collection. This is the type of card that younger me dreamed of owning back in the day. I wish they never stopped making Preferred, it was truly one of the greatest sets Panini ever made (and it never gets talked about these days for some reason). This card is not for sale or trade. #thehobby #whodoyoucollect #booklet #gameused #legends

Tony DeMarco won the welterweight title with a 14th round TKO of Johnny Saxton at Boston Garden in Boston, Massachusetts #OnThisDay in 1955.

Following a good opening round, DeMarco reportedly allowed Saxton to grapple, clinch and stall on the inside. The fight followed that familiar Saxton pattern for several rounds, until DeMarco punched Saxton's mouthpiece out with two well-placed punches in round 9.

In the 12th round, DeMarco wore Saxton down with his relentless offense until he actually seemed to punch himself out. And in the 13th, Saxton finally had nothing more to give, and the fight was stopped after Saxton took a sustained assault with his gloves down at his sides.

"I knew I had him when he went down in the 14th round. When he fell back through the ropes, I said to myself 'this is it'."

"The Bodysnatcher" Mike McCallum got revenge for his only pro loss while making his third defense of the WBA middleweight title by 12 round split decision over Sumbu Kalambay at the Stade Louis II in Fontvieille, Monaco #OnThisDay in 1991.

McCallum seemed nearly unbeatable early in his career, but he he dropped a decision to Kalambay when he tried to move up and win a title in a new division. He eventually captured the same title when it was vacant and got back in with the tricky Kalambay.

A ringside report said:

"Zairean-born Kalambay had McCallum in trouble several times with clever combinations and knocked out the title-holder's gumshield in the ninth round.

But the tough Jamaican recovered to win and said he now planned to unify the title by challenging International Boxing Federation champion Michael Nunn of the United States."

"It was a difficult fight, but I deserved to win because I kept walking on him," McCallum said.

Emile Griffith began his fateful trilogy with Benny "Kid" Paret and became a world champion when he won the welterweight title with a 13th round KO at the Convention Center in Miami Beach, Florida #OnThisDay in 1961.

This was the first fight of their ultimately tragic three-fight series, and it was an entertaining and competitive fight featuring Griffith attempting to follow trainer Gil Clancy's advice that he punch with Paret, who threw a lot of punches. Griffith was generally sharper with his combinations when he actually remembered to follow the plan. 

"I didn't do a lot of things my manager told me," Griffith later said.

For his part, Paret did some good work inside and was shifting the momentum his way going into the later rounds. Griffith's corner woke him up with a slap to the face before the 13th round.

Griffith later said, "I got angry when he smacked me [in round 13] and I just went after [Paret]."

Paret ate a left hand that made him drop his guard, and another left hand landed that dropped him. He remained there on the canvas in the same position, almost like he was ignoring the count, and he had to be moved by his corner well after the count reached 10 and the fight ended.

Paret's team said he couldn't count to 10 in English, which meant he couldn't understand the count. "This was the first time he'd ever been knocked down," said Paret's manager Manny Alfaro.

"[Griffith] can be five times better than he showed tonight," Clancy told reporters. "I know what he can do. It's like you have a half-back who can take three steps out and cut into the line. And he takes three steps out and then runs out of the park. You saw one-fifth of Emile Griffith tonight."

Chris Byrd stopped Vitali Klitschko to become a world champion and win the WBO heavyweight title when Vitali Klitschko stayed in his corner with a shoulder injury after round 9 at the Estrel Convention Center in Berlin, Germany #OnThisDay in 2000.

Byrd, an Olympic silver medalist whose only loss to that point was a stoppage against Ike Ibeabuchi, was actually a substitute for Donovan "Razor" Ruddock, who pulled out with a stomach issue. Byrd was out-sized and outgunned for much of the fight, but he stayed patient before eventually pressing the issue in the later rounds

A ringside report said:

"Byrd, the 1992 Olympic silver medalist, gave away 34 pounds and six inches to the 6-foot-8 Klitschko, who appeared to be completely puzzled by the Amercan's ducking and bobbing.

By the end of the fight, the crowd was cheering Byrd, who backed up Klitschko in several rounds with a flurry of punches and taunted the Ukrainian."

"I just knew he gave up and I was the new champ," Byrd said. "I myself didn't expect to win."

Klitschko was eventually diagnosed with a torn rotator cuff. "[My shoulder] had pain since the third round," he said. "I hit with heavy pain."

The loss hurt Klitschko's reputation for a few years, though he erased the sting by going to war with Lennox Lewis in 2003.

7ème Ciel : C’est leur 7ème album à atteindre le sommet du Billboard 200. Une domination sans partage depuis 2018. 📈

Contre vents et marées : Malgré les nouvelles règles de Billboard (fin des ventes multiples, retrait des données YouTube), BTS a brisé tous les obstacles grâce à la force pure de l'ARMY. 💪🔥

Le chiffre 13 : Ils ont réussi à placer 13 chansons de l'album dans le Hot 100. En gros, 13% du classement américain appartient à BTS cette semaine ! 🤯

Double Doublé : Ils sont les seuls artistes coréens à avoir réussi le "Double No. 1" à deux reprises (la première fois avec BE en 2020).

De leurs débuts dans un petit garage à Séoul jusqu'au sommet du monde, les 13 ans de carrière de BTS sont aujourd'hui gravés dans le marbre. Comme ils le disent dans leur titre « 2.0 » : "Être comme BTS, ce n'est pas facile". 🎤🦁

Magic Johnson reveló que Larry Bird lo llamó después del diagnóstico de VIH: "Casi podías escucharnos a los dos, con lágrimas en los ojos. Y estaba afectado porque me llamó".

 El mundo del baloncesto se sorprendió cuando Magic Johnson anunció que era VIH positivo en 1991. Con la falta de conciencia sobre la enfermedad en ese momento, muchos jugadores como Karl Malone se sintieron incómodos al compartir la cancha con Johnson.  Sin embargo, muchos expresaron su simpatía por Johnson, incluyendo a Bird.

 Como muchos evitaban a Johnson en ese momento, Bird decidió tomar el teléfono de su viejo amigo y hablar sobre el diagnóstico.  Johnson describió cómo se sintió al recibir esa llamada y lo que los dos compartieron entre sí.

▪️ "Me llamó.  Estábamos hablando, es solo, '¿Cómo estás?  Escuché sobre eso. Casi puedes escucharnos a los dos con algunas lágrimas en los ojos.  Y me emociono porque me llamó.  Cuando algo te sucede y luego descubres quiénes son realmente tus amigos y las personas que realmente se preocupan por ti”.

 Cuando Magic recibió su diagnóstico, muchos creyeron que el VIH sería una sentencia de muerte instantánea.  Sin embargo, Magic ha vivido una larga vida satisfactoria con su diagnóstico y sigue siendo una cara visible en los medios de baloncesto.  Además, pudo regresar a la cancha durante su mejor momento y jugar para el Dream Team olímpico de 1992.

caption:
Kelra Sang Penerus Warisan Gold Lane ONIC Siap Hadapi Geek Fam

Hai, MedForians!

Memasuki Week 2 MPL Indonesia Season 17, sorotan tertuju pada konsistensi Sang Raja Langit, ONIC. Penampilan luar biasa diperlihatkan oleh pemain andalannya, Kelra, yang sukses mencuri perhatian pada pekan pembuka. Kelra terbukti mampu mengungguli Arfy saat melawan Alter Ego dan menghadirkan kekacauan nyata bagi pertahanan RRQ.

Performa impresif ini seolah menegaskan bahwa ONIC kembali menjadi penantang gelar juara terkuat musim ini. Lebih dari sekadar permainan apik, kehadiran Kelra menjadi pengingat sejarah mengenai ketajaman ONIC dalam menemukan suksesor di posisi Gold Lane. Kelra kini berdiri sejajar dalam deretan nama besar seperti Spade, Sasa, CW, Savero, hingga Skylar.

Di sisi lain, Geek Fam yang sempat tampil kurang meyakinkan di pekan pertama harus bekerja ekstra keras untuk menahan laju dominasi ini. Namun, harapan baru muncul bagi Geek Fam dengan hadirnya Ye3 di posisi EXP Laner yang berpotensi melakoni debut dan memberikan kejutan tak terduga.

Mampukah Kelra melampaui warisan para pendahulunya di Gold Lane, atau justru Geek Fam yang berhasil memutus tren positif sang pemuncak klasemen? Pastikan kamu tidak melewatkan pertarungan sengit ini!

Ο Δημήτρης Χορν με την πρώτη του σύζυγο Ρίτα Φιλίππου, στα χρόνια του έγγαμου βίου τους στα τέλη της δεκαετίας του ’40. Η γνωριμία τους ξεκινά μέσα στην Κατοχή, το 1941, σε ένα πάρτι πίσω από το Μουσείο της Πατησίων και πολύ γρήγορα μετατρέπεται σε έναν τρυφερό έρωτα. Εκείνος, μόλις είκοσι ετών, κάνει τα πρώτα του βήματα στο θέατρο Κοτοπούλη, δίπλα στον Δημήτρη Μυράτ, στη μουσική κωμωδία "Το ταξίδι του γάμου", κερδίζοντας κοινό και κριτικούς. Η Ρίτα, μαζί με την αδερφή της Λέλα, κάθεται στις πρώτες θέσεις, παρακολουθώντας με θαυμασμό και συγκίνηση κάθε εμφάνιση, επιστρέφοντας ξανά και ξανά για να τον δει. Ο γάμος τους τον Αύγουστο του 1942 σφραγίζει αυτό το συναίσθημα, χαρίζοντας μια κοινή πορεία δέκα χρόνων, γεμάτη εκτίμηση και αλληλοστήριξη, όπως ο ίδιος αργότερα αφηγείται. Το 1952, η συνάντηση με την Έλλη Λαμπέτη ανοίγει ένα νέο κεφάλαιο, έντονο και συναρπαστικό, που οδηγεί στη λήξη του πρώτου γάμου. Ο δεσμός τους γίνεται θρύλος, γεμάτος πάθος και σπουδαίες θεατρικές στιγμές. Το 1967 ακολουθεί δεύτερος γάμος με την Άννα Γουλανδρή, μια σχέση βαθιάς αγάπης και σεβασμού που διαρκεί είκοσι χρόνια και χαρίζει ισορροπία και πληρότητα. Η γνωριμία τους ξεκινούσε από τα νεανικά τους χρόνια. Ο ηθοποιός ανέφερε πως είχαν συναντηθεί πολύ νωρίς, σε μια περίοδο που διαμόρφωναν ακόμη τα πρώτα τους βήματα, με το αστραφτερό χαμόγελό της να του μένει αξέχαστο από την πρώτη στιγμή. Ο θάνατός της το 1988 τον καταρράκωσε βαθιά, ένα γεγονός που δυσκολεύτηκε πολύ να ξεπεράσει. Η πορεία του Δημήτρη Χορν μοιάζει με μυθιστόρημα, γεμάτο μνημειώδεις ερμηνείες και μια παρουσία που καθόρισε το ελληνικό θέατρο, κρατώντας ζωντανή την αύρα μιας εποχής που συνεχίζει να συγκινεί κάθε νέα ματιά πάνω στην τέχνη.  Οι συνεργασίες του άφησαν στίγμα, οι ρόλοι του έγιναν σημείο αναφοράς, ενώ το κοινό ακολουθούσε με αφοσίωση κάθε του βήμα. Έτσι η μορφή του παραμένει ζωντανή, πλέον ως ανάμνηση αλλά ως διαρκής παρουσία που εμπνέει και συνομιλεί με κάθε εποχή, κρατώντας ανοιχτό έναν διάλογο ανάμεσα στο παρελθόν και στο σήμερα, εκεί όπου το θέατρο βρίσκει ξανά την ουσία του ανθρώπου.#arisloupasis#legends#art#vintagestyle

रमेश भाटकर यांचा जन्म ३ ऑगस्ट १९४९ रोजी झाला. त्यांचे वडील वासूदेव भाटकर हे गायक आणि संगीत दिग्दर्शक होते. महाविद्यालयीन काळात ते उत्तम जलतरणपटू आणि खो-खो खेळाडू होते.त्यांनी अभिनयाची सुरुवात रंगभूमीवरून केली. ‘अश्रूंची झाली फुले’ या नाटकामुळे त्यांना विशेष ओळख मिळाली. त्याशिवाय ‘केव्हातरी पहाटे’, ‘अखेर तू येशीलच’, ‘राहू केतू’, ‘मुक्ता’ ही त्यांची गाजलेली नाटके आहेत.१९७७ मध्ये ‘चांदोबा चांदोबा भागलास का’ या चित्रपटातून त्यांनी पदार्पण केले. त्यानंतर ‘अष्टविनायक’, ‘दुनिया करी सलाम’, ‘आपली माणसं’, ‘माहेरची साडी’ अशा अनेक चित्रपटांत त्यांनी लक्षवेधी भूमिका केल्या. ‘माहेरची साडी’ मुळे ते घराघरात पोहोचले.‘हॅलो इन्स्पेक्टर’ ही त्यांची मालिका प्रचंड गाजली. त्यांचा भारदस्त आवाज आणि पोलिस अधिकाऱ्याची ताठर भूमिका आजही लक्षात राहते. अनेक तरुणांना त्यांच्या भूमिकेतून प्रेरणा मिळाली.
त्यांच्या पत्नी न्यायमूर्ती मृदुला भाटकर यांनी ‘हे सांगायला हवं’ या पुस्तकात त्यांच्या आयुष्यातील कठीण प्रसंगांचे अनुभव मांडले आहेत.
९८ व्या अखिल भारतीय मराठी नाट्य संमेलनात त्यांना ‘जीवनगौरव’ पुरस्कार देऊन सन्मानित करण्यात आले. ४ फेब्रुवारी २०१९ रोजी त्यांनी या जगाचा निरोप घेतला. त्यांच्या पश्चात पत्नी मृदुला भाटकर, मुलगा हर्षवर्धन आणि सून असा परिवार आहे.
त्यांचा अभिनय, आवाज आणि व्यक्तिमत्त्व आजही चाहत्यांच्या मनात जिवंत आहे.#marathimanoranjan #rameshbhatkar #remembering #legends

This casual Ibis hotel parking lot in Le Mans saw some cool, but two very special cars last year;

The Jaguar XJ220 is number 6 of only 8 pre-production cars built by Jaguar. Number 6 has been used extensively by Jaguar for testing, including high-speed attempts. This car has an ANS-spec engine with 700 bhp. It is fitted with original BBS alloys, as the production versions with flat sides were not available at the time.

006 features in many press articles from the period, as it was also used as the press test car. The car differs from the production car with many slightly different parts. It is looked after by Don Law Racing, the official XJ220 specialist, and has been kept as original as possible while remaining roadworthy.

The 2005 Ford GT is an unique one too, since it has been owned by no one else than Jeremy Clarkson back when it launched, and it had some features on the famous Top Gear show, the one we probably all know and love, and grew up with in my case.

The Approaching Storm by Alan Dean Foster
Book 57/261 (22 BBY)

The Approaching Storm is yet another novel that roped me in with its political elements. While this book didn’t contain lots of action, it still gave a great story to lead right into Attack of the Clones. Alan Dean Foster loves his descriptive alliterations, which I appreciated as a reader who visualizes scenes as I read them. It was very interesting to read about the growing Separatist movement and the buildup to secession, as well as how Ansion would have affected the galaxy in one way or another. Up to this point, this novel may dive the deepest into Anakin’s psyche, feelings, emotions, and struggles, which plays right into the character who we know to be driven by passion and emotion.

After finishing The Approaching Storm, I originally felt it deserved 5/10 ⭐️ but after a little bit of contemplation, I think it should get more like 6.5/10

Christie's will present its first London sale dedicated to South Asian Modern + Contemporary art in seven years, marking a return to King Street after 2019. Titled ‘Sublime Shadows: South Asian Art from a Distinguished Collection,’ the auction will take place on 11th June 2026 and brings together 93 works from a private collection developed between the 1990s and early 2000s, reflecting a sustained engagement with the region’s modern artistic developments.

The sale places particular emphasis on the artistic legacy of Bengal, featuring key works by Ganesh Pyne and Meera Mukherjee, alongside a 1971 canvas by V. S. Gaitonde. The selection is further complemented by works from K. K. Hebbar and Jogen Chowdhury, presenting a broader view of South Asian modernism through artists who shaped its evolving visual language.

So special to see my old friend @leeprestonhair Preston again. Decades later, still connected, still aligned, still passionate. That’s the power of this industry real relationships that stand the test of time.

From my early days in 1995 on that first trip to Australia with @goldwelluki stepping onto the stage for Crusade, to Hair Expo, to Congress with Michelle Sewell those weren’t just shows they were moments that shaped a legacy. A journey built on creativity, courage, and consistency.

And now? We look at the next generation our children, our teams, the future of hairdressing and it all comes full circle.

Seeing a Bermondsey girl back in London, thriving, with a beautiful family that’s what success really looks like. Not just awards or stages, but life, growth, and connection.

Because here’s the truth 

Life is short. Stay connected. Stay relevant. Stay inspired.
The relationships you nurture are the foundation of your strength personally and professionally.

This industry isn’t just about hair.
It’s about legacy, commitment,  passion but most
of all education.

Michael Jordan sólo temió a una persona en toda su carrera en el baloncesto: "Me mantuvo humilde, pero me desafió"

  Michael Jordan describe en su libro Driven From Within, qué tipo de desafíos impondría Coach Dean Smith al equipo y a Jordan personalmente. Cómo su entrenador universitario Dean Smith fue el único hombre en el baloncesto al que realmente temió.

▪️"El entrenador Smith te desafiaría mentalmente. Recuerdo mi primer error. Fui a la línea de fondo e intenté hacer un movimiento de reserva, y él simplemente gritó "¿dónde crees que estás? ¿Crees que has vuelto a la Escuela secundaria E.A. Laney? Pues no. Estás en la universidad. ¿Crees que fue un buen tiro? Obviamente no puedes decir que sí. Te hizo pensar. Nunca maldijo a nadie. Era el coach perfecto para mí. Me mantuvo humilde, pero me desafió. Me dio confianza al darme elogios cuando pensaba que los necesitaba".

 "Pero tenía mucho miedo del entrenador Smith porque él era un gran nombre en el estado de Carolina del Norte y yo era un niño de una ciudad pequeña. Nunca pensé en llamarlo de otra manera que no fuera Coach Smith. Era intimidante la forma en que controlaba las prácticas. Nunca había visto una práctica como lo fue en Carolina del Norte. Cada minuto estaba pensado. Si se suponía que un simulacro terminaría a las 3:10, terminaba a las 3:10 y comenzaba el siguiente. Nunca Pensé que era el tipo de persona que se tiraba al suelo como lo hacía en la práctica. Gritaba y vociferaba. Nunca hacía eso en el juego. Me sorprendió cómo entró en la práctica, cómo controlaba cada minuto, cómo jugaba, cómo enseñaba. Hacía que la práctica fuera un desafío, lo cual era lo que me gustaba. Logró que aprender fuera divertido".

Mike Weaver scored a vicious last-round come-from-behind 15th round KO of "Big" John Tate to won the WBA heavyweight title at the Stokley Athletics Center in Knoxville, Tennessee #OnThisDay in 1980.

Tate racked up the points by pushing Weaver to the ropes and catching him by surprise in a number of rounds. Weaver later said he knew he was falling behind, and he was surprised by how well Tate moved for his size and how quick he was. Indeed Tate did surprisingly well at times.

Weaver lost a point a low blows in round 14 and between rounds his corner begged him to attack and go for the knockout in the last round. Tate, apparently caught up in the excitement of his loud hometown crowd, stood and brawled too much in the last round rather than boxing or stalling, and he ended up paying the price.

When Tate went to the ropes in round 15, Weaver caught up to him with a right hand and follow up left hook that dropped Tate to the canvas in a heap and ended everyone's evening.

When life feels invasive and boundaries are unclear, people search for a place that represents structure and protection. Koshoy-Korgon, associated with the epic of Manas and the warrior Koshoy, is less about warfare and more about defining territory — inner and outer. Even in ruins, the fortress communicates clarity.

Visitors enter the perimeter and stop at the center, taking in the remaining walls. Then they mentally mark their own boundaries: where they give too much, where they stay silent, where they allow intrusion. Walking the perimeter afterward, they form one clear rule they are willing to uphold for the next month. Not a philosophy. A rule.

Leaving Koshoy-Korgon, many feel composed and steady. Not defensive, not aggressive — simply firm. And if confidence shows up as a decision rather than an emotion, there is nothing to fear. Stability often looks exactly like that.

"Sugar" Ray Leonard brutally dispatched Dave "Boy" Green while making his first defense of the WBC welterweight title by 4th round KO at the Capitol Center in Landover, Maryland #OnThisDay in 1980.

Green previously held the British and European junior welterweight titles, but he was only two fights removed from a bad loss to European welterweight champion Joergen Hansen. Meanwhile Leonard was an Olympic gold medalist and now world champion on a tear through the sport.

Leonard dominated the early rounds and drew blood from Green's nose in the 1st. Leonard did more damage with a hard jab until the 4th round, when Leonard closed the show in spectacular and vicious fashion.

An incredible combination punctuated by a hook and uppercut put Green to sleep for a number of minutes. There was no use for a count and no count was given.

"The majority of the time, my speed is the difference in any fight," Leonard said. "My speed will overcome experience or power or whatever I meet in the ring. I'm not surprised that I got in the first punch or the most punches. That's the way I fight."

REVIEW ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Cornelia Funke brings us a beautifully illustrated children’s picture book of mythological creatures from traditions and cultures around the world. This book goes beyond the basic unicorn/dragon concepts (although they certainly appear) to engage a young reader’s sight and imagination as well as potentially capture a new interest in previously unexplored worlds. 

What’s done really well is the emphasis on color, the situating of each creature in its own unique patrimony, and the brief explanation of known lore around the creature. 

For parents choosing this for their children or teachers for a classroom, please be aware that the author does discuss historical ways to kill or hurt some of the creatures. In this former teacher’s opinion, the book would be 5⭐️ if these pieces were rewritten to reflect instead a sense of respect and admiration for the creatures’ abilities. 53 Years Ago Today: Ken Norton Broke Muhammad Ali's Jaw 😳

Ken Norton famously fractured Muhammad Ali's jaw while winning a 12 round split decision at the Sports Arena in San Diego, California #OnThisDay in 1973.

After his first pro loss to new unified heavyweight champ "Smokin'" Joe Frazier, Ali scored 10 straight wins to prove he still belonged at the top and deserved the throne. Unfortunately for Ali, Frazier's trainer Eddie Futch was in Norton's corner and encouraged him to jab with Ali and bend low just the same.

Before the opening round was done, Ali reporedtly suffered a broken jaw. 

"I think I've got a broken jaw," Ali told his corner. He fought through the 2nd round and his corner asked if he wanted to quit before the next round began. Ali said no, but he got on his toes and the crowd went wild at the sight of the quick-footed legend performing a few signature moves. That didn't last long, however.

Norton not only jabbed with Ali as Futch instructed, he mixed heavier punches that kept Ali guesssing. When Ali tired and tried to push Norton around, Norton used his physical strength to pull out of clinches. Ali simply couldn't get any rhythm offensively.

Finally in the 11th round, Ali caught Norton with a handful of combinations and appeared briefly rejuvenated. Then Norton landed a right hand in the 12th round that hurt the former and future champ and sent him to the corner, where he soaked up more punishment and appeared happy to hear the final bell.

"In my mind I had the fight all the way," said Norton. "I wasn't surprised when he came out flat-footed. I knew he'd try to bomb me. Then when he started dancing I just kept up with him. At his age and weighing 221 pounds you can't move up on your toes like that without getting tired. Nobody can."

It is said that legends are born in truth. One of my greatest childhood memories is listening to stories of Tansen and Baiju Bawra , the two celebrated musicians. Tansen, a disciple of Swami Haridas Dagar is the center of many such stories, tales and history. Tansen was said to be able to burn the world with his music while Baiju Bawra was said to be able to melt marble with the purity of his notes. 

Years of circulation among generations of people leads to some tweaking in the authenticity of such history. But one truth that I always derived from such legends is the absolute power of music to move people, create bonds, to allow them to imagine the impossible but not just dream but also bring solace for all the difficulties that come with reality. It's astounding to hear and feel something so profound that it seems like music itself can create or destroy the most inanimate objects and to find comfort in such imagination.

Visiting the monument which is the foundation of such tales at Fatehpur Sikri was an experience of a lifetime. It was a condensation of years of imagined places and structures.The very resonance of that music made the place irresistible and unforgettable for me and generations of music lovers. 😍😍

Un trattore che ha dato un contributo enorme a un’epoca di ripresa e pragmatismo: il DEUTZ F1L 514 è stato un protagonista dei campi europei nei primi anni ’50 e per molti anni a seguire.

In un mondo agricolo che chiedeva macchine semplici, robuste e facili da mantenere, rispose con una meccanica essenziale e affidabile – diventando il punto di riferimento per intere generazioni di agricoltori.

Le sue caratteristiche? Solide e allo stesso tempo all’avanguardia:

⚙ Motore monocilindrico DEUTZ
💨 Raffreddamento ad aria, marchio distintivo dell’azienda
🐎 Potenza: 15 CV
⚖ Peso massimo: circa 1.900 kg
🌱 Disponibile in versione da pieno campo e “plantage”, per utilizzi specializzati

Con oltre 30.000 esemplari prodotti in quasi un decennio, l’F1L 514 ha dimostrato che la vera forza risiede nella capacità di unire energia inarrestabile a facilità d’uso e manutenzione.

Ne hai mai visto uno al lavoro, o magari nascosto in qualche cascina?
