५० वर्षांहून अधिक काळ लोटला आहे, जेव्हापासून Meena Kumari यांनी या क्रूर जगाला अलविदा करून एका शांत जगात प्रस्थान केले. अनेक दुःख, वेदना आणि तुटलेल्या नात्यांनी भरलेले तिचे आयुष्य अखेर संपले. पिढ्या बदलल्या, पण तिच्या चाहत्यांचे प्रेम आजही तितकेच कायम आहे—ते तिच्यावर प्रेम करतात, तिची वेदना जाणवतात आणि तिच्या दुःखासाठी जबाबदार मानल्या जाणाऱ्यांवर राग व्यक्त करतात.
१ ऑगस्ट १९३३ रोजी जन्मलेल्या मीना कुमारी यांचे बालपण अत्यंत कठीण परिस्थितीत गेले. त्यांचे वडील अली बक्स हे संगीतकार व अभिनेते होते, तर आई इक्बाल बेगम या गायिका होत्या. आर्थिक अडचणींमुळे त्यांना अनाथाश्रमात सोडण्याचा विचारही झाला होता, पण नंतर त्यांना परत घरी आणले गेले.
त्यांच्या अभिनय कारकिर्दीची सुरुवात बालकलाकार म्हणून झाली. Baiju Bawra या चित्रपटाने त्यांना प्रचंड लोकप्रियता मिळवून दिली आणि त्यांना फिल्मफेअर पुरस्कारही मिळाला. पुढे Parineeta, Sahib Bibi Aur Ghulam आणि Pakeezah यांसारख्या चित्रपटांनी त्यांच्या अभिनयाला अमरत्व दिले. “साहिब बीबी और गुलाम” मधील छोट्या बहूची भूमिका ही जगातील उत्कृष्ट अभिनयांपैकी एक मानली जाते.
त्यांच्या वैयक्तिक आयुष्यात मात्र अनेक संघर्ष होते. त्यांनी दिग्दर्शक Kamal Amrohi यांच्याशी विवाह केला, पण हे नाते अनेक अडचणींमुळे तुटले. मद्यपानाच्या व्यसनामुळे त्यांचे आरोग्य खालावले आणि त्यांना लिव्हर सिरॉसिस झाला.
३१ मार्च १९७२ रोजी त्यांचे निधन झाले. अल्पायुष्यात त्यांनी आपल्या अभिनयाने अमिट छाप सोडली. आजही त्यांचे डोळे, त्यातील भावना आणि त्यांची वेदना प्रेक्षकांच्या मनात जिवंत आहे.
मीना जींना खरी श्रद्धांजली म्हणजे त्यांच्या कलाकृतींची आठवण ठेवणे.#marathimanoranjan #meenakumari #legends

Robert Fleck, born in Glasgow, came through the youth, and made his debut at Ibrox in 1984 at just 18. No fuss, just straight into it.

First goal a year later against St Mirren — and from there he kicked on. 104 appearances, 34 goals in his first spell. Not bad going, but it was the 86/87 season where he really showed what he was about.

22 goals in 48 games. Four hat-tricks. One in the league, one in Europe within days. Different level.

Formed a deadly partnership with McCoist — the two of them firing Rangers to the league title, the club’s first in nine years. Massive.

Big moments anaw — that equaliser in the 4-4 game against Celtic when we were up against it. Always had that bit of fight in him.

Sharp finisher, worked his socks off, and turned up in big games. Exactly what you want.

Fleck himself said it best about playing with Davie Cooper:
“I don’t know how many of my goals Coop set up but it was probably most of them. It was a striker’s dream.”

Left in 87.
One of our own, doing it in the royal blue.

Ciągnik, który wniósł ogromny wkład w erę odnowy i pragmatyzmu: DEUTZ F1L 514 odegrał kluczową rolę na europejskich polach na początku lat 50. i przez wiele kolejnych lat.

W świecie rolnictwa, który wymagał prostych, solidnych i łatwych w utrzymaniu maszyn, model ten odpowiedział na te potrzeby niezbędnymi i niezawodnymi rozwiązaniami mechanicznymi, stając się punktem odniesienia dla całych pokoleń rolników.

Jego cechy? Solidny i jednocześnie najnowocześniejszy:

⚙  Jednocylindrowy silnik DEUTZ
💨 Chłodzenie powietrzem
🐎 Moc: 15 KM
⚖  Masa maksymalna: około 1900 kg
🌱 Dostępny w wersji polowej i do zastosowań specjalistycznych

Z ponad 30 000 wyprodukowanych egzemplarzy w ciągu prawie dekady, F1L 514 udowodnił, że prawdziwa siła tkwi w zdolności łączenia niepowstrzymanej energii z łatwością użytkowania i konserwacji.

Widziałeś kiedyś takiego w pracy lub schowanego w gospodarstwie?

#DeutzFahr #WhereverTheresALand #DeutzFahrmer #Legends

A tractor that made a huge contribution to an era of recovery and pragmatism: the DEUTZ F1L 514 was a key player in European fields in the early 1950s and for many years thereafter.

In an agricultural world that demanded simple, robust, and easy-to-maintain machines, it responded with essential and reliable mechanics – turning into the benchmark for entire generations of farmers.

Its features? Solid and cutting-edge at the same time:

⚙ DEUTZ single-cylinder engine
💨 Air cooling, the company’s trademark
🐎 Power: 15 HP
⚖ Maximum weight: approximately 1,900 kg
🌱 Available in open field and “plantage” versions for specialised uses

With 30,000+ units manufactured over almost a decade, the F1L 514 proved that real strength lies in the ability to bring together unstoppable energy and ease of use and maintenance.

Have you ever seen one at work, or tucked away on a farm?
Send us a photo of your DEUTZ-FAHR #LEGENDS: it will be included in our gallery, dedicated to its history.

🌊🐉 The Dragon of West Lake, Hanoi 🐉🌊

I love myths like this:
Long before the city of Hanoi came to life, when the land was still wild and restless, there lived a powerful dragon king beneath the waters — a guardian of the earth and sky.

Half spirit, half dragon, he was no ordinary creature. He was a protector of the waters, watching over rivers, lakes, and the people who depended on them, a sacred being, a symbol of power, fertility, and life-giving rain.

One day, a terrible creature appeared — a cunning, shape-shifting fox spirit that terrorized the land.

The battle between dragon and beast shook the earth. The sky darkened, winds howled, and the ground trembled beneath their clash. To defeat the fox, the dragon summoned the forces he ruled — water itself.

The land flooded. The battlefield disappeared beneath rising waves. And when the storm finally settled, the fox was gone… but in its place remained a vast, shimmering body of water.

That is how West Lake was born.

But the dragon did not leave.

It is said he still lingers there — unseen beneath the surface — a guardian spirit, protecting the waters and the life around.

And maybe that’s the beauty of West Lake —
not just what lies on the surface, but what lives in the stories beneath it.

✨🐉🌊

Een klassieker die generaties boeren hebben gekend: de DEUTZ F1L 514.

Begin jaren ’50 werd deze tractor een vaste waarde op Europese velden. In een landbouwsector die behoefte had aan eenvoudige, robuuste en onderhoudsvriendelijke machines bood hij precies wat nodig was: betrouwbare en overzichtelijke techniek.

Voor velen was dit één van de eerste tractors op het erf.

Zijn kenmerken:
⚙ DEUTZ eencilindermotor
💨 Luchtkoeling – het handelsmerk van DEUTZ
🐎 Vermogen: 15 pk
⚖ Gewicht: circa 1.900 kg
🌱 Verkrijgbaar in standaarduitvoering en boomgaarduitvoering

Met meer dan 30.000 geproduceerde exemplaren in bijna tien jaar werd de F1L 514 een tractor waar generaties boeren op vertrouwden.

Heb jij er ooit één zien werken, of staat er misschien nog één op een erf? Stuur ons een foto van jouw DEUTZ-FAHR 💚

After 12 hour days working from 9am to 9pm with R. D. Burman, Louiz Banks never let his true passion take a backseat.

Every night, he would pack up his keyboards and head straight to the iconic Hotel Sea Rock, where a different kind of magic awaited.
There, alongside an exceptional lineup …..
Braz Gonsalves on Saxophone
Yvonne Gonsalves on Vocal
Lou Hilt on Bass
Buster Grant on Drums
and Ozzie Fernandes on Guitar ….. Louiz would immerse himself in the world of jazz.

Despite his rising success in the film industry, Louiz remained deeply rooted in what truly defined him.

Because for him, jazz was never just music ..… it was identity, passion and pure freedom.

Day 27
🎶 “If tomorrow never comes…” — Garth Brooks

Today I found out that one of my island buddies passed away… just shy of his 80th birthday.

And it hit me. Hard.

It took me right back to my dad… one of those legends.
The good ones. The ones who somehow feel like they leave too soon no matter how long they lived.

The kind of people who make you feel better—lighter, happier—whether you spent one minute with them or twelve hours.
The ones who leave you with a full heart and a good laugh every single time.

I sat there crying, trying to write a message to his wife… because I cannot even imagine losing your best friend… your person… the love of your life.

And it made me look at mine.

I grabbed LuLee a little tighter today.
Probably a little longer than usual.

I even told him… don’t you dare die on me. So many times before today … don’t we all do this ?
(Selfish? Maybe. Real? Absolutely.)

Because the truth is… we don’t get to control any of this.
We don’t know how many tomorrows we get.

But we do get today.

So love them harder.
Laugh longer.
Say the things.
Hold on a little tighter.

Because if tomorrow never comes…
I want today to have meant everything. 🤍

🌟 Learn how to play Marcel with Boro!

⚡️ Marcel is an incredibly versatile hero that has a high skill ceiling; you need to be able to read situations correctly and adapt your playstyle and build for each game separately, so do not be dismoralized when it doesn’t work out instantly when learning him.

1️⃣Emblem: 
Support Main Emblem
4% Movement Speed — 8 Hybrid Defense
Wilderness Blessing
Quantum Charge — Concussive Blast

I like 4% Movement Speed + Quantum Charge in most games, although 8 Hybrid Defense + Concussive Blast can be a good alternative when playing against a strong mid pair like Khaleed+Zetian so you sustain a bit more and help your mage fast clearing mid.

2️⃣Build:
Marcel can build a lot of items for different situations. I’ll try to keep it short although it’s not easy.

For the start you should take play with Green Roam (Heal) so that you can get EXP+Gold from Waves and help your sustain once you unlock roam.

🔥 I like going Tough Boots into strong Mage comps or heavy CC comps (Mage+Joy/Baxia/Gato for example)
If the enemy doesn’t have extreme cc you can build Cooldown Reduction Boots.

Now, you should communicate to your Mage if he needs to build Antiheal or if you can do it early. If you have a Valentina/Pharsa, let them build Damage on their first item and you go Dominance Ice

🏆 Marcel Builds:

Boots>Dominance Ice>Flask of the Oasis>Oracle>Athena>Immortality/Guardian Helmet

🤝 If your Mage builds antiheal early, you can get away with building Thunderbelt which scales extremely well on him:

Boots>Thunderbelt>Dominance Ice>Flask of the Oasis>Athena>Immortality

❗️ Keep in mind that Marcel does NOT gain any HP from Items/Emblems, so having effects that reduce damage taken (Athena for Mages) or grant you increased shield (Oracle/Flask) allows you to play more aggressive and find plays..

Time to take a break from all the semester 2 dumps that have been saturating your insta feed while I quickly rewind to a time where we weren’t all sat at home bored out of our minds

That’s right, you guessed it! It’s time for the Christie Cup results post 🙌🙌🙌🙌

As for some reason I, myself wasn’t invited along for the big day? So here is a beautifully written summary of from Quack: 

‘It was a super hot and sunny day which was gorgeous but did not work well for some peoples armpits or backs (stitch 😬)
First game was against Manchester which we won pretty comfortably 2-0 (and it could’ve been a few more if Jess Fleming knew where the goal was when she shot her reverse hit 🥴🥴🥴) 
Keira Owen (our lovely 2s captain) was so good in the first game we had to keep her on for the second match against Liverpool 🫰🫰 This was the grudge match (because we have beaten them in every game this year 🔥🔥 but they won the league because they are cheating scum 👎👎👎👎👎👎 (it’s a long story to do with the union I won’t bore you) so basically this was both for pride and for the Christie cup medal 🥇

It was a tense game. We scored early in the second half to make it 1-0 and then got 3 green cards 🫣🫣 2 of the green cards were in the last 4 mins of the game and they had taken their keeper off so we were playing with 8 outfield players vs 11 of their outfield players 🥴 Luckily our defence are rock solid and we held on to win Christie cup!! COME ONNNN Big day. Big win. Big boozy bus home! 😉😉😉’ 

And just quickly thought I’d chuck in the last 2 BUCS game results so that can be done and dusted 😚

The 2s drew 4-4 against Northumbria 1s, lucy/rob scoring a flick after the whistle blew to make it 4-4🙌🙌🙌 they were 4-1 down in the second half at one point but the girls brought it back 🫰 #legends 

5s lost 4-0 unlucky. 

Now’s the part we all rejoice as I’m wrapping it all up cause hopefully you all actually read to the end of that so I can wish you all a restful and happy Easter break 💞💞💞 big things to come next semester!!! Varsity, half mara, 3 peaks and of course @ellajack_x ‘s BIG WEEKEND 😝😝😝ooooh I cannot bloody wait!!! 

See you next sem x

Ein Keller voller Geschichten – und harter Runden.

Kleines Throwback zum Training im legendären Boxkeller der Ritze.

Im Ring zu stehen, in dem schon die Klitschko-Brüder, Henry Maske, Dariusz Michalczewski und viele weitere standen, macht das Ganze für mich sehr besonders.

Aber nicht nur das professionelle Boxen hat hier seine Spuren hinterlassen…
Auf dem Kiez wurden hier früher auch Dinge geregelt, harte Runden geboxt und Geschichten geschrieben, die man sich heute nur noch erzählen kann.

Der Boxkeller und die Ritze haben ihre eigene Geschichte.
Und man spürt sie in jedem Moment.

Vielen Dank an Coach @petersboxteam – Legende im Boxkeller und ehemaliger Sparringspartner u.a. von Felix Sturm und den Klitschko-Brüdern – für die Möglichkeit, dort zu trainieren.
Es war eine richtig harte Einheit, aber eine ganz besondere für mich.

Some careers define excellence. Others define an entire sport.

Mario Andretti has done both.

The North Carolina Motorsports Association is proud to announce that Mario Andretti will be honored at the NCMA Motorsports Industry Awards (June 3, Charlotte Convention Center) for his extraordinary impact on motorsports and his place among the most accomplished drivers in racing history.

Andretti’s career is unmatched, as the only driver to win the Indianapolis 500, Daytona 500, and a Formula One World Championship. His success across disciplines, continents, and generations has made his name synonymous with greatness.

But this night is about more than recognition; it’s about experience. Attendees will have the rare opportunity to see and hear from Andretti in person, including a special fireside chat alongside Richard Petty, hosted by Kyle Petty, bringing together for the first time three of the most influential voices the sport has ever known.

The evening will also recognize other outstanding contributors to the sport:
🏁 The Petty Family — NCMA Philanthropy Award
🏁 Venturini Motorsports — North Carolina Motorsports Industry Award
🏁 Dave Moody — Jim Hunter Memorial Media Award

Surrounded by industry leaders, innovators, and decision-makers from across North Carolina’s motorsports ecosystem, this is a night where legacy, leadership, and the business of motorsports come together.

If you are a fan of motorsports, this is a program and evening you won’t want to miss.

Bill Withers

4 juillet 1938 – quelque part à Slab Fork, WV, naissait une légende. Bill Withers, sans en avoir l’air, allait marquer des générations entières.

Il n’était peut-être pas le soleil, mais il a éclairé bien des vies, illuminant le monde de ses mélodies intemporelles. “Ain’t No Sunshine”, “Lean on Me”, “Lovely Day”… Des chansons susceptibles de réchauffer l’âme, comme une lueur douce et persistante. Mais aussi les cœurs et les corps… 

Puis, un jour, le 30 mars 2020, l’homme s’est éclipsé, sans bruit, du côté de Los Angeles, CA.

Mais les étoiles ne s’éteignent jamais vraiment.

Pensées pour lui…

Bill Withers

July 4, 1938 – somewhere in Slab Fork, WV, a legend was born. Bill Withers, unassuming yet destined to leave his mark on generations to come.

He may not have been the sun, but he lit up countless lives, illuminating the world with his timeless melodies. “Ain’t No Sunshine,” “Lean on Me,” “Lovely Day”… Songs that warm the soul like a gentle, lasting glow. But also the heart and the body…

Then, one day, on March 30, 2020, he quietly slipped away in Los Angeles, CA.

But stars never truly fade.

Remembering him…

HE Shaykh Yahya As-Samadaani writes:

Prince Ogborin, son of Oba Dagburewe of Idowa who was once the Awujale of Ijebu Ode,  after him came Prince Kulatan son of Oba Ajalorun of Ijebu Ife.

Eyita son of Roye of Ipara who happened to be a nephew to Oba Kuyelu, the Akarigbo of Sagamu.

After Eyita came Regun the owner of Eluku deity in Itunpate.

Eyita was the hunter that killed the elephant and it was him that discovered lagoon at the present Ebute Ikorodu and went to inform his uncle Oba Koyelu of his amazing discovery of lagoon.

It was through Eyita that Akarigbo and his children: Oga Lasunwon ,Sekumade and others came to see the lagoon.

They all went back to Sagamu and later Sekumade came back to settle at Ipakodo
and his brothers came to settle down in Ikorodu.

Ọga was a farmer but begat no child. 
He was cultivating Odu vegetable. 
People patronizing him from Sagamu and suburbs use to call the Odu vegetation Oko-odu- Oga.

Prince Ogborin, the first ever settler built the first ever building in Ikorodu called OJU-IBA where all that came after him paid homage to him including Oba Kuyelu, his children and their predecessors: Kulatan, Eyita and Regun.

Ogborin had many deities for peaceful settlement,which include oro-otaigbo,  agemo and Eluku. 

Eyita with his babalawo settled at Ita-Aro and his lastborn Omole settled at ItunEyita while his babalawo Ogbemolu settled in Ijomu area..

Oba Kulatan was the first cowned king and the first bearer of a beaded crown titled EYILOKU which he got from his father Ajalorun of Ijebu Ife even his first male child was crowned after him.

It was the crowning of his child that raised the dust that led to his forceful removal and taking the crown to Ijebu Ode. 

This is what informed the retrieval of the crown from Ijebu Ode and renamed Ayangbure when Oba Alagbe became the Oba. 

No Oba wore a beaded crown before Oba Alagbe except Oba Kulatan the first crowned Oba and his child after him.

Regun settled at Itunpate with his Eluku deity.

Others like like Muleruwa, Lisa, Losi, Salu and a host of others came after..

They came to Prince Ogborin to pay homage.

The original version of “War” was originally supposed to be @TheTemptations next big single until Berry Gordy went against it and later re-recorded the song with a different Motown singer—becoming a smash hit.

In 1969, one of Motown’s most successful songwriters and producers—Norman Whitfield and Barrett Strong wrote a song that was a direct message to the infamous Vietnam War that was going on at the time. The song would be titled “War.” The Temptations were the first to record the song and was intended to be released as their next big single in 1970. That was until Motown founder Berry Gordy and the group itself insisted that it shouldn’t be released as their next single because they feared it would ruin their reputation. Many fans across the country, especially college students, wrote multiple letters to Motown and demanded them to release the song as a single during the midst of the anti-war movement that was happening. Motown didn’t want to risk of ruining the groups clean image so they denied it. Norman Whitfield fought hard against Motown to get it released as a single and they came up with a compromise. The song can be a single but with a different artist. “War” would be given to the soulful singer Edwin Starr, who gave it a more edger and funkier approach to the song than the Tempts version. The rest was history. As of today, the song is still relevant after all these years. Some things never change.

José "Chegüi" Torres became boxing's first Puerto Rican light heavyweight champion by winning the title with a 9th round TKO of Willie Pastrano at Madison Square Garden in New York #OnThisDay in 1965.

"Willie played 'the champ' the way old champions are played in movies that make grown men sob," wrote Bob Waters for Newsday. "He was never in the fight, but until the sixth round the knowledge of 83 fight helped him escape the destruction that seemed so inevitable."

Pastrano fought his usual slippery and defensive fight, and he avoided many of Torres' punches in the early rounds. Pastrano's movement couldn't keep a relentless Torres from doing damage in the meanwhile, however. Through five rounds, Pastrano's face and body were marked up and red.

In round 6, a combination punctuated by a left hook followed by a hook to the body put Pastrano down for the first time in 13 years as a professional fighter. When Pastrano got up, he made his way through the next three rounds on heart and experience alone before the bout was stopped between rounds by the referee.

"He took my best punches," Torres said. "I was surprised. I had hoped to wear him down little by little, I guess I did that."

"I had to stop it," Referee Johnny LoBianco said. "He had nothing left. As slippery as he is, he was just avoiding the other man."

Pastrano sobbed in the ring while his trainer Angelo Dundee protested the stoppage. Pastrano retired and never fought again.

Before exiting The Garden, Torres grabbed the microphone and shouted, "Puerto Rico forever!"

Jarní autogramiáda osobností Moravy ✒️ Krásná setkání s úžasnými lidmi, kterých si moc vážím ❤️

Rozhodně nejvíc bylo setkání se sestrami Machatovými. Bývalé členky baletu Státního divadla v Brně a velice úspěšné gymnastky. Paní Hana Bubníková Machatová mě jeden semestr učila balet na Masarykově univerzitě. Sport jsem si nějaký vybrat musela a balet byl jasná volba, protože to pro mě byly kredity "zadarmo". Jakmile jsem si přišla ke stolku pro podpis, její první reakce byla "Já Vás odněkud znám!". Zůstala jsem úplně v šoku. Od doby jejích lekcí jsme se neviděly a hlavně uplynulo více jak 10 let! Tak jsem se připomněla, načež následovaly hned otázky "Jak se máš a co děláš?". Její sestra, paní Jiřina Langová Machatová byla úplně stejně zlatá. Musím říct, že jsem se na ně těšila, obzvlášť na paní Hanu, ale tohle mi teda úplně vyrazilo dech 💕

Další neskutečné setkání bylo se zasloužilým umělcem panem Richardem Novákem. Představovat takovou legendu je myslím úplně zbytečné. Moc si vážím toho, že jsem se s ním mohla setkat i osobně a totéž platí i o setkání s paní Jarmilou Krátkou, když už jsem u té opery.

Velice milým setkáním, i když ne ojedinělým (a za to jsem moc ráda 🙂), bylo s Martinem Dvořákem. Poprvé jsem ho na jevišti viděla na jeho absolventském koncertu, ze kterého si ale pamatuji asi tak jen jeden mlhavý útržek (za to se Vám, Martine, zpětně omlouvám). Ono taky v necelých 4 letech člověk ještě nestíhá vše pobrat 😀 Další - opravdové setkání pak proběhlo už za mých studií na TK. Jeho tanec a choreografie se jistě hluboce dotkly nejednoho diváka a festival ProART mohu jen doporučit 🙂

Od tance zpátky rovnou ke zpěvu a to rovnou za další legendou panem Kerndlem. V závěsu pak se zpěváky a herci MdB Tomášem Sagherem, Jiřím Machem a tanečnici Renatou Mrózkovou.
Svůj maraton sbírání autogramů a fotek jsem zakončila u herce Antonína Kaly, kterého mnozí jistě znají jako Oskara Blechu ze seriálu Létající Čestmír.
Bylo to skvělé nedělní dopoledne! 🙂

•In loving memory to dear Gloria May Josephine Svensson "Gloria Swanson". Chicago,March 27, 1899 – April 4, 1983. "Cecil B. DeMille's muse". 

"without a doubt, she's a stunningly beautiful woman with great style and elegance. Her success is well deserved, just like everyone else’s moreover, Dolores is utterly charming.”
-The New Movie Magazine, 1930.

Gloria Swanson and Dolores Del Río were two of the great pioneering legends of silent cinema and Hollywood’s Golden Age. Both experienced the heyday of silent film and faced the challenge of the transition to sound cinema. Renowned for their artistry, iconic beauty, and great elegance, they were also pioneers who defined cinematic stardom in the 20th century. 
The friendship between Gloria Swanson and Dolores del Río began with mutual admiration in the 1920s, a time of great success for the Latin American star during Hollywood’s silent film era. Friendships, major events, and shared moments—Swanson’s visits to Del Río’s home—cemented a relationship and created memorable moments between the two stars. 
They posed together in the mid-1970s, cementing their status as living legends of silent cinema and Hollywood’s Golden Age before passing away in the same year (1983). Gloria: April 4; Dolores: April 11.

The Song That Outgrew the Awards.
John Hartford’s "Gentle on My Mind" was more than a hit; it was a phenomenon. After a record-breaking run of BMI Achievement Awards, BMI’s Robert J. Burton retired it from further citations by presenting an award to Glaser Publications—a milestone reserved for only the most enduring standards.
While the original Glaser Brothers version recorded in January 1970, for the ...tick...tick...tick... soundtrack, captured the era's smooth cinematic sound, the 2026 mix takes it back to the roots. By blending the brothers' 1970 vocal tracks with a high-energy, drum-driven bluegrass arrangement, we’re honoring the song’s past while driving it into the future.
Listen to a classic, reborn for a new generation of Outlaws.
🪕 The Banjo: Pure Bluegrass grit.
🥁 The Beat: Modern, driving, and relentless.
🎙️ The Vocals: The unmistakable Glaser Brothers harmony.

Marvelous Marvin Hagler was knocked down for the first time as he defended the middleweight title with a 10th round TKO of Juan Domingo Roldán at the Riviera Hotel & Casino SuperStar Centerin Las Vegas, Nevada #OnThisDay in 1984.

Roldán was a hard-nosed and hard-hitting fighter from Argentina with about the same amount of experience as Hagler. On paper the fight was a high level matchup, but Hagler was made a wide favorite.

Not long into the fight, Roldán landed a left hand that was half clubbing hook, half pull-down, and Hagler went to the canvas. It was incorrectly called a knockdown despite Hagler's protest, and he made Roldán pay for it.

In the 3rd round, Hagler connected on a right hand that badly hurt Roldán and sent him to the deck. The punch also started to close Roldán's right eye.

Roldán got to his corner after the round and reportedly said, "I can't fight anymore. I can't see him." His manager, famous Argentine boxing figure Juan Carlos "Tito" Lectoure, replied, "You've still got your left eye. You must have courage. You're beating him and you can take him out with one punch. You must forget the pain. You can be the world champion."

From there it was only a matter of time, as the fight became more about Roldán's toughness. Hagler went to Roldán's body and targeted his shut eye, and after nearly each round the ringside physician came tearing into his corner to check the eye.

Finally after round 9, when Roldán was asked if he wanted to continue, Lectoure interrupted and told officials that of course Roldán would continue. Lectoure then slapped Roldán and said, "You can't quit. You must have courage. Be brave. You can still win. Throw the big punch. Knock him out!"

But it was not to be. Roldán answered the bell for round 10, but only more punishment awaited him. Hagler landed a combination that sent Roldán down again. He got up before signaling that he wanted no more.

"That was no knockdown," Hagler insisted. "I slipped and I told the ref."

The Jet d'Eau Mobile Walkway

This special object was designed as a part of a larger project called the «Esplanade du Jet d'Eau». The esplanade runs for a distance of about 200 m from the wharf to the rotunda around the Jet d’Eau. The decking is about 4 m wide and is made from solid oak beams sourced exclusively from the forests of Geneva. Thirty metres from the wharf, the esplanade crosses an access channel to the port for small vessels. To maintain the fluidity of the space, we designed a whole new type of walkway. The structure rises like a wave to let boats go through, without interrupting the flow of pedestrians who can keep on walking.

When Words Fall Away: The Hidden Power of Silence in Relationships 🌌🤫

Ever found yourself in a moment so rich that speaking felt unnecessary? Silence isn’t just the absence of sound; it’s a beautiful canvas where deeper connections can flourish. In a world clamoring for attention, sometimes the most profound connections are forged in quiet moments. 

What does silence bring to the table? First, it creates a space for reflection. Whether you’re curled up on the couch with a loved one or enjoying a serene walk in nature, those moments of shared quietude give us the chance to truly absorb each other’s presence. It’s in those sweet pauses that understanding blossoms—no words needed.

Secondly, silence encourages vulnerability. It’s in the moments we let go of the need to fill the air with chatter that we can reveal our true selves. When we embrace silence together, it signals safety—an open invitation to share our innermost thoughts and emotions when we’re ready. That’s where trust is built; a bond strengthened by knowing it’s okay to be just ourselves, even when words escape us. 

And let’s not forget about the beauty of non-verbal communication! A simple glance, a touch, or even a shared smile during silences can convey what words often fail to express. It’s amazing how our bodies communicate unspoken feelings. Embrace the power of these moments to deepen your connection and create shared memories that echo beyond sound. 

So, the next time you're together, consider embracing the silence. Let it wrap around you like a cozy blanket and watch as your bond gets richer. Who knows what profound moments await when you let silence speak for itself?

Who knew Erie, PA could be so…eerie 👀

Local legend suggests that if you’re looking to encounter the supernatural, the Erie Cemetery is where you need to be as this cemetery holds TWO ghost stories! 

🦇 The Vampire Crypt is perhaps the cemetery’s most popular legend. Standing near Chestnut Street, this nameless crypt has been rumored to be the final resting place of a vampire. According to legend, in the 1800s, a Romanian businessman had passed away from consumption and was laid to rest in the crypt. With only an ornate ‘V’/ bat decorating the structure, the rumors swirled of him possibly being a vampire— and it didn’t help that bodies with puncture wounds were showing up around town.  It’s said that one night a caretaker had come across the vampire and tried burning his crypt before sealing it shut. 

🔮 The Witches Circle is the cemetery’s second legend and depicts the story of local coven leaders being buried within the circle of headstones within the 1800s. It’s said that during the ceremony, Satan himself rose from the ground to take the Witches back to hell with him and leaving the headstones charred— which you can still see today. Many have tired to clean the marks, but nothing has removed them.

Some rivalries don’t just define races — they define eras.

From the explosive battles between Max Hoff and René Holten Poulsen, to the consistency and class of Ken Wallace vs Adam Van Koeverden, canoe sprint has gifted us moments where milliseconds decide legacies.

Josef Dostál and Fernando Pimenta pushing limits. David Cal and Attila Vajda in unforgettable showdowns. And the timeless greatness of legends like Knut Holmann and Antonio Rossi.

Data keeps these legends alive. Every race time, every head-to-head, every split tells a story that goes beyond memory — it allows us to relive greatness, compare generations, and truly understand the level they reached.

This sport isn’t just about speed — it’s about history, data, and the stories behind every stroke. Because when you look deeper, the numbers don’t take away the magic… they reveal it.

Matthew Saad Muhammad all but ended John Conteh's career with a 4th round TKO while making his second defense of the WBC light heavyweight title at the Resorts International in Atlantic City, New Jersey #OnThisDay in 1980.

There were rumors that Conteh had been struggling with personal issues leading into the fight, but there were also questions about whether Saad Muhammad could have survived a bad cut in their first fight without the help of a banned substance that stopped the bleeding.

Unlike their first fight, which was hard-fought and close, Saad Muhammad seized momentum early and made Conteh defensive. By the 3rd round, Conteh was a few rounds down on the cards.

A right hand began Conteh's issues in the 4th and a follow-up punch put him down. He beat the count, and a combination put him down again. He was up again, and a hook sent him down for a third time. And when he got up once more, another right hand scored the fourth knockdown.

Conteh had no quit in him and got up again. Saad Muhammad attacked for one final time, landing a hook, and Conteh lost his footing. The fight was stopped right there.

"He came up each time, because that is what you expect of a champion—like he was," Saad Muhammad said. "But face it, he is a former champion. I have proven that I'm the best light heavyweight to everyone. And all I want now more than anything is to get the other half of the title, which Marvin Johnson is holding now."

"I got hit with the first right and never recovered," Conteh said. "I didn't realize I was down so many times. I wasn't trying to fight a defensive fight, that's a credit to the champion. I didn't get into the fight. Perhaps I should have taken the bull by the horns early. Matt's defense is his offense. He is dangerous when you allow him to take control of the fight, which I did."

Michael Moorer earned a lackluster 12 round majority decision over Vaughn Bean while making his second defense of the IBF heavyweight title at the Hilton Hotel in Las Vegas, Nevada #OnThisDay in 1997.

While Bean wasn't a bad fighter, he was still relatively unheralded before the bout, making it more embarrassing for Moorer that an unknown fighter made him look bad. 

Moorer was aggressive early on, but he became lazy or complacent in the middle rounds, forcing his trainer Teddy Atlas to make the fight a weird spectacle.

Atlas annoyingly yelled his fighter between rounds, as early as round 3 saying, "[Bean] didn't believe he belonged here when he stepped into the ring. You're starting to let him think he belongs here."

Bean worked well to the body in the middle rounds even though he never had Moorer in trouble. But Moorer fought uninspired and Atlas again let him know it.

After round 9, Atlas pulled out a bulky cellphone from the era and put it in Moorer's face. "Michael, [your son] is crying, and he's embarrassed. He's asking, 'How come Daddy doesn't want to be a champion anymore?'"

Bean also waited around too much, though he did win the 12th round, making the scores close as Moorer won. Bean's promoter Butch Lewis yelled at anyone within earshot that Bean was robbed and the judges were somehow biased.

"It was his style," Moorer said. "I don't want to take anything away from him. Styles make fights."

"I thought I pulled it out," Bean said. "I wanted to win."

Wong Fei-hung (1847–1924) was a real-life Chinese physician, martial artist, and folk hero from Foshan in Guangdong during the late Qing dynasty and early Republic era. Born into a martial arts family, he trained under his father in the Hung Gar style, a Southern Chinese system known for its strong stances and powerful hand techniques. Beyond his reputation as a skilled fighter, Wong was widely respected as a traditional Chinese medicine doctor, operating a clinic called Po Chi Lam where he treated the poor, often free of charge. His life unfolded during a time of social unrest, foreign influence, and internal upheaval in China, and his actions reflected a strong sense of righteousness, discipline, and loyalty to his community.

While many legends have exaggerated his feats, historical accounts describe him as a disciplined teacher and community protector rather than a wandering vigilante. He became associated with groups that upheld order and defended local interests, but his true legacy lies in his dual role as both healer and martial artist. After his death, stories about him grew through operas, novels, and later films, transforming him into a symbol of justice and Chinese cultural pride. Despite the mythologizing, Wong Fei-hung remains grounded in reality as a man who used his skills not for fame, but to serve and protect the people around him.

Astrud Gilberto: The Voice of Bossa Nova

Astrud Gilberto remains, in the hearts of many, “The Girl from Ipanema,” a voice that introduced Brazilian Bossa Nova to the world. Her soft, understated delivery gave the genre an unmistakable elegance.

Born Astrud Evangelina Weinert on March 29, 1940, in Salvador, Brazil, and raised in Rio de Janeiro, Astrud was immersed in music from an early age. Her life changed in 1963 when she joined her husband, João Gilberto, in a New York recording session with Stan Getz and Antônio Carlos Jobim. Asked to sing in English, she recorded “The Girl from Ipanema,” a song that became a global sensation, winning a Grammy in 1965.

The success of Getz/Gilberto launched her solo career. She released over 15 albums, blending Bossa Nova, Jazz, and Pop, with highlights such as:

- The Astrud Gilberto Album (1965): Featuring “Agua de Beber” and “Dindi.” 

- Look to the Rainbow (1966): A collaboration with arranger Gil Evans. 

- Beach Samba (1967): A mix of Brazilian and American influences. 

- Now (1972): A more experimental and socially conscious work, showing her evolution as an artist.

- Jungle (2002): One of her later albums, incorporating electronic elements into her sound.

She performed worldwide, making Bossa Nova an international sound.

Though she stepped away from the spotlight in the 1980s, Astrud’s influence endured. Her music remains a touchstone for generations of artists.

Astrud Gilberto passed away on June 5, 2023, in Philadelphia, PA, but her voice still drifts through time—soft, timeless, and forever evocative of Rio’s golden shores.

On what would have been her 84th birthday, we celebrate the woman who brought Bossa Nova to the world.

Happy Celestial Birthday, Astrud!

"The Brown Bomber" Joe Louis brutally dispatched Johnny Paychek with a 2nd round TKO to make his 10th defense of the heavyweight title at Madison Square Garden in New York #OnThisDay in 1940.

Paychek was 25-years-old, but experienced with 50 pro fights. He was born John Pacek, and was also a top amateur in Chicago, where he won Golden Gloves titles. The problem was Louis was already one of boxing's greatest punchers, and he was in his prime and easily taking out anyone who wasn't up to the task.

Paychek was in deep trouble against Louis very early on. More than 11,000 watched as Paychek was sent to the canvas three times in the 1st round, and it only got worse.

In the 2nd round, a destructive right hand caught Paychek clean and flattened him, ending the fight. The referee counted, but Paychek waved the count off himself as he stretched out, dazed.

"[The fight was] just a picnic," Louis said. "Yeah, it was mighty easy. Can't say it was the easiest fight I ever had. At least, I can't say it was the shortest."

After the fight, a reporter asked Paychek if he was afraid. "Afraid? No, it wasn't that," he replied. "But god, how that man can hit. I didn't remember a thing after the first knockdown. I just knew I was supposed to get up, and keep going. Before I was hit I was thinking so much about defense that I couldn't let a blow go. How that man can hit!"

Bezoek van de 41-jarige Maarten Martens aan 'The Office Of Mister Michel'. Maarten zette zijn eerste voetbalstappen bij Klauwaerts Bassevelde waarna hij als 8-jarige in de jeugdopleiding belandde van RSC Anderlecht. In het seizoen 2003-2004 werd hij toegevoegd aan de kern van het 1ste elftal. Happy 73rd birthday to former lead singer of @TheTemptations, Mr. Louis Price! Born on this day in 1953 in Chicago, Illinois -

Today, Tempts fans, we're celebrating another living legends birthday! Formerly of The Temptations, Chicago's own @louispricerecords turns 73 years old. He was the Temptations lead singer fron 1977 to 1979. During his years with the Temptations, he replaced the powerhouse vocalist Dennis Edwards and right around that time, the group moved from Motown to Atlantic Records. While at Atlantic, they recorded two albums and an unreleased one. The two that were released are “Hear To Tempt You” in 1977 and ”Bareback” in 1978. Both albums, nor any of their singles didn’t achieve much success, in a result of leaving Atlantic and going back home to Motown but with Dennis Edwards returning. 

Price would perform as a member of the Drifters throughout the 80s and even did some studio work for Heatwave during their album “Current.” By the late 80s, Price would sign to Motown as a solo artist and released his self-titled album in 1991. The following year, he would appear in the iconic basketball film “White Men Can’t Jump.” As of today in 2026, Price continues to sing and perform at concerts throughout the country.

Muhammad Ali played with George Chuvalo for 15 rounds as he made his third defense of the heavyweight title at Maple Leaf Gardens in Toronto, Canada #OnThisDay in 1966.

It was a tumultuous few years for Ali, who just had his draft status changed prior to this fight. He was supposed to fight Ernie Terrel, but the fight fell through and Chuvalo replaced him, with the bout moving from Chicago to Toronto.

Ali made a show of it, lifting his arms in the early rounds as he allowed Chuvalo to punch him to the body. Chuvalo landed several low blows, but it excited the more than 13,000 fans in attendance. Unfortunately for Chuvalo, that was the only success he had.

Angelo Dundee, Ali's trainer, pleaded with his charge to do more offensively and Ali did. For the remainder of the bout, Ali connected so often that he made his own hands sore.

True to form, Chuvalo absorbed everything without issue though his face swelled. He simply didn't win rounds. He did eventually wear Ali out by simply staying the distance, though.

"Chuvalo is the toughest fighter I've ever met," Ali said. "Liston is the best puncher, but he's not as tough."

An Ode to a Legend Behind the Wheel
Some men don’t just drive
they dance with danger,
they speak the language of curves,they tame the mountains as if they were their own.
Hari was one of them.
Perhaps the finest we have ever seen behind four wheels in this country not just a race driver, but a force of nature.

I remember those days,
standing as a marshal on dusty rally tracks,heart racing with every engine roar waiting for him and the other champions .
And then he would arrive.
Not rushed, not reckless
but with a calm flamboyance,
a master at work,gliding through impossible bends as though the road itself made way for him.

There was that day at Chausa with Hari etched forever in memory.....
He came down the track, fast too fast for the zone.
The mountain caught him in a minor crash.
We rushed, concerned, shaken.
And I asked him,
“How did this happen?”
He smiled. Calm. Unshaken.
“Paaji.... no brakes. They failed on the downhill.”
For a moment, time stood still.
No brakes.A steep descent.
And yet,control, composure, command.
That was him.
Not just courage,
but grace under fire.....
Not just speed,
but soul......
Today, the tracks feel quieter.
The mountains echo a little less.
But legends like him don’t leave
they become stories,
they become standards,
they become inspiration.

Every young driver who dares a sharp turn,every engine that roars into the unknown carries a piece of him forward.
Legends never leave us.
They simply take the chequered flag and move ahead
guiding the rest of us from above beyond the horizon.

"The Ragamuffin Man" Lloyd Honeyghan avenged his only loss by regaining the WBC welterweight title with a 3rd round KO of Jorge Vaca at Wembley Arena in London, England #OnThisDay in 1988.

Honeyghan captured the title with an upset win over Donald Curry two years earlier, but sanctioning organization nonsense split up the undisputed title. Vaca then won the title when a technicality tipped a decision his way after a cut ended their first fight,

With this win, Honeyghan became the first British fighter to regain the welterweight title in more than 70 years, since Ted "Kid" Lewis regained it from Jack Britton in 1917.

Vaca was cut on his forehead in the opening round, likely from a headbutt when the two collided inside. In the 3rd round, Honeyghan got Vaca to the ropes and unloaded, sending him down with a body shot that kept him on the deck for the full count.

"This is the sweetest moment of my life—even better than when I won the title in the first place," Honeyghan said. "I decided from the start to mix up my attacks. I let Vaca have it to the head, then switched to the body. He never knew what I was going to do next."

"I thought I could get an advantage by staying on the ropes," Vaca said. "That proved to be a big mistake."

Samsung Galaxy S26 FE... com Exynos 2500?

A vida dos fãs da linha Galaxy FE da Samsung não é das mais fáceis.

Não adianta querer defender a marca sul-coreana neste caso, pois os usuários do Fan Edition sempre ficam com a impressão de que estão relegados ao F*ck Edition.

Um vazamento recente aponta para um futuro Galaxy S26 FE com o processador Exynos 2500, que entrega pelo menos 33% menos performance que o atual Exynos 2600.

Sei que a escolha aqui é para diferenciar essa série dos tops de linha Galaxy S26, além da tentativa de equacionar financeiramente o modelo.

Mesmo assim: isso aqui é um tanto quanto injusto.

Por que isso é ruim?

O principal argumento para criticar a possível decisão da Samsung em colocar o Exynos 2500 no Galaxy S26 FE vai além da queda nominal de desempenho, que já é algo gritante.

Pense um pouco: todo e qualquer smartphone que chega ao mercado hoje conta com vários recursos de inteligência artificial.

E muitos usuários querem trabalhar de forma nativa com alguns dos chatbots generativos mais potentes do mercado.

Com um processador menos potente, a experiência de uso será diretamente afetada, com uma degradação que tende mais a irritar do que convencer a quem quer pagar menos.

Agora, some isso ao fato de que esse dispositivo (muito provavelmente) vai contar com apenas 8 GB de RAM (e não 12 GB, como os modelos top de linha e premium), e você tem o combo da irritação se construindo diante dos nossos olhos.

Difícil defender isso aqui...

Se tudo isso acontecer, o Samsung Galaxy S26 FE terá enormes dificuldades para competir com concorrentes na mesma faixa de preço que entregam mais no desempenho.

Neste contexto, o iPhone 17e, qualquer smartphone Android com Snapdragon 8 Elite e até mesmo um POCO X8 Pro da vida (importado, pois o preço do nacional é um assalto) se torna uma opção melhor do que o S26 FE.

Sei que todas as marcas estão meio desesperadas para reduzir os custos de fabricação dos seus dispositivos, o que vai resultar em decisões polêmicas como essa.

Mas o que a Samsung está fazendo neste caso é colocar a identidade da linha FE ainda mais em risco.

👻 Who watches from the window on Mount Street? 👻

I grew up hearing stories about a window on Mount Street, Mullingar — a window where, if you looked up, you might catch a face staring back.

The ghostly face was said to be that of a woman, gazing across to where the gallows once stood on Jail Hill.

Caught forever in time…

Some believed she was the lover — or perhaps the sister — of Brian Seery, a man hanged for assault.

It later transpired that Seery may have been innocent of the crime.

When I was young, the window was painted black — whether to stop people seeing the face… or to spare that poor soul from reliving the hanging, I’m not sure.

Does anyone know — is that window still black today? 👀

The location is above Golden Hill takeaway.

Three leagues.
Three insane 5-a-side teams.

La Liga.
Premier League.
Serie A.

All packed with legends… but only one wins.

La Liga brings pure technical dominance.
Lionel Messi + Cristiano Ronaldo in the same team is already broken…
add Andrés Iniesta control and Sergio Ramos aggression… it’s chaos.

Premier League brings power + intensity.
Thierry Henry, Wayne Rooney, Kevin De Bruyne…
physical, direct, relentless.

Serie A brings balance + IQ.
Diego Maradona magic, Zinedine Zidane control, Andrea Pirlo vision…
with Paolo Maldini locking it down.

No weaknesses.
Just different styles of dominance.

So the real question is…

Does technique win?
Does power win?
Or does balance win?

A Legendary Night at the 2026 Luxury Oscar Gala
A Moment with an Icon: @ericrobertsactor 🎬✨
There are moments in this industry that simply take your breath away. Attending the 2026 Luxury Oscar Gala was an honor in itself, but witnessing the legendary Eric Roberts receive his Lifetime Achievement Award was a masterclass in prolific talent.
With over 735 productions to his name, Mr. Roberts is one of the most prolific screen actor of all time—but beyond the staggering numbers is a man of incredible warmth and “peaceful energy.”
I had the distinct pleasure of sitting with him for a few moments, engaging in conversation that was as enlightening as it was full of laughter. As someone who has always harbored a deep desire for the craft of acting—and having long admired the Roberts family, including the brilliant Julia Roberts—this connection felt like a full-circle moment for my soul.
What struck me most wasn’t just his accolades, but his spirit. He was relaxed, fun, and truly present. From my point of view, there wasn’t a single dull moment in his presence. To the supporters and fans of his craft: I can personally testify that the man behind the screen is as humble and gracious as they come.
Thank you, Mr. Roberts, for the hospitality and the genuine greeting. It was a celebration I won’t soon forget.
Shall we cross paths again, Mr. Roberts? I look forward to it. 🥂

Team Liquid ID Libas EVOS 2-0, Dominasi Mutlak di Pekan Pertama MPL ID Season 17!

Hai, MedForians!

Panggung MPL ID Season 17 langsung memanas di pekan pertama lewat duel antara Team Liquid ID (TLID) melawan EVOS. Namun, alih-alih pertandingan sengit yang berlarut-larut, Team Liquid ID justru memberikan pelajaran berharga dengan kemenangan telak 2-0 tanpa balas.

Sejak gim pertama, TLID sudah menunjukkan kematangan strategi yang luar biasa. Lyoni yang menggunakan Hilda sukses mendominasi fase early game melawan EVOS dengan mengawasi pergerakan pro player Macan Putih tersebut. Strategi ini efektif mematikan pergerakan Fanny milik Alberttt yang kesulitan mengamankan Turtle maupun Lord. Kyouu yang tampil gemilang sebagai MVP gim pertama dengan hero Moskov, mencatatkan GPM tinggi sebesar 752 dan KDA 2/0/8 yang sangat solid.

Dominasi berlanjut ke gim kedua meski EVOS mencoba bereksperimen dengan draf anti-mainstream, seperti menempatkan Valentina di Exp Lane. Keputusan tersebut justru menjadi celah bagi TLID untuk terus menekan. Aran yang menggunakan hero fighter Sora berhasil mengontrol tempo permainan hingga dinobatkan sebagai MVP gim kedua dengan KDA 4/0/5.

Hanya dalam waktu kurang dari 30 menit secara total, Team Liquid ID membuktikan bahwa penguasaan makro dan fleksibilitas draf adalah kunci kemenangan mereka. Hasil ini menjadi sinyal kuat bagi tim lain sekaligus pekerjaan rumah besar bagi EVOS untuk segera membenahi identitas permainan mereka di musim ini.

Bagaimana tanggapan kamu mengenai eksperimen draf dari EVOS kali ini? Apakah Team Liquid ID bakal jadi calon kuat juara musim ini?

Buck "Tombstone" Smith fought from welterweight to middleweight during the 1980s and 90s, eventually fighting into the 2000s and higher weights and ending his career having scored an incredible 121 KO.

In May of 1992, Smith fought two different opponents in two different states on the same day. He started by knocking out Marco Davis in Wichita, Kansas, then drove to Oklahoma City and won a decision over Rodney Jones.

When asked about his record, Smith said, "I'm not fighting one bum a month. I'm fighting three or four."

The Celtic Caudron Card Game is gaining followers on Gamefound. Join us at
https://gamefound.com/en/projects/knotted-mechanic-games/the-celtic-cauldron

Each card relates to a specific character or moment from the myth of Branwen; and has a unique impact on gameplay.
The parts that make up the cards are:

Card Value: This appears twice. Once at the top of the card, which is easy to see when fanning cards in your hand. It is again at the bottom, which is easy to see if other cards cover the top and is readable from any angle across the table.

Illustration: Each card has beautiful illustration from @inktron

Effect text: Not all cards have effects, for those that do, this text may swing the odds in your favour.

Effect Symbol: This specifies when the text will trigger.

Debut pemain asal Indonesia, Aeronnshikii, bersama Team Liquid PH di pekan pertama ajang MPL PH Season 17 terpaksa ditunda akibat kendala administratif yang belum rampung, bukan karena masalah performa, kesiapan, maupun strategi tim. Klarifikasi resmi ini disampaikan langsung oleh pihak Team Liquid PH melalui akun Instagram mereka untuk meredam berbagai spekulasi yang sempat beredar di kalangan komunitas, terutama karena pemain Indonesia lainnya seperti Savero sudah bisa langsung tampil bersama ONIC PH. Meskipun secara teknis Aeronnshikii kemungkinan besar sudah siap untuk bertanding, proses legalitas kompetisi lintas region ini memang kerap memakan waktu. Saat ini, pihak manajemen sedang berupaya keras menyelesaikan seluruh keperluan administrasi tersebut secepat mungkin dan sangat mengapresiasi kesabaran para penggemar. Jika semua kendala ini telah teratasi, penampilan perdana Aeronnshikii diprediksi akan tetap menjadi salah satu momen yang paling ditunggu-tunggu dalam kompetisi Mobile Legends bergengsi di Filipina tersebut.

Menurut mimin, Berita Aeronshikiii yang merupakan player Indonesia yang bermain di proscene Filipina yang memang sangat bergengsi karena telah winstreak Mseries. Awalnya ini adalah peluang yang sangat membanggakan namun takdir berkata lain. Mau tidak mau, berharap agar ada kesempatan lain di lain waktu supaya ada player indo yang akan bermain di proscene Filipina.

Since there is no specific story to this picture from 1901, here are some ghost tales from around the lake.

Like we saw in recent posts, White Ladies are everywhere. The archetype is Barbara, daughter of the 15th-century Lord of Castello Dal Pozzo. Imprisoned in the tower for refusing an arranged marriage, she is said to have died longing for her exiled lover, Matteo. Her stillness, gazing from the high window, became the blueprint. The shores should never really get dark, considering how many of them there are, illuminating the windows of the Ex Grand Hotel Eden, the gardens of Villa Branca and Villa Palazzolla, the waters around Castelli di Cannero and the ruins of the fortress above Calde'. 

Calde' is blessed with 3 sorts of ghosts. The White Lady, but also below the medieval ruins, where soldiers fell during 16th-century sieges, the air is said to grow heavy. Across the water, the Rocca di Arona & Angera as well as the Fortino & Castello in Laveno allegedly harbor the imprint of combat. Near the Ossario, which houses the mingled bones of fallen soldiers, locals have reported an unnatural, cold stillness, occasionally broken by the metallic ring of sabers or distant artillery echoing when the wind hits the stone just right.

But in Calde' there supposedly also are Picchiettini - knocking spirits in the old abandoned lime kiln. They produce a rhythmic, dry thudding of metal against rock, an acoustic phenomenon also documented in the granite quarries of Baveno & the deep mines of Maccagno. The tireless pounding of the hardworking people who carved the lake's wealth from its mountains, if you believe it.

A counterpoint to the weightless White Ladies is the ghost of the Portatrice of Feriolo. Clad in dark, heavy clothing & bent under the weight of a pack basket filled with rocks, she represents the grueling toil of these women. Along the border ridges, she is joined by the Donna del Sacco, the spirit of a female smuggler who died under the burden of her contraband. Their labored footsteps are allegedly still tracing the steep mountain paths.

And just so we’re clear, I made a few mistakes in the video. Janet Jackson’s last album still debuted at number one. There’s no exact sales data because it was released independently, but a number one debut is still a number one debut. Her previous album sold about 1.5 million, and historically Janet averages between 6 to 10 million per album. And let’s be real, them tour tickets? Her residency is selling out. That tells you everything. The people still love her. The people are still supporting her. Y’all just not buying music like that anymore.

And with streaming, it’s harder to get those exact numbers anyway. So now we look at trending, hits, number one debuts, chart longevity, cultural impact. That still deserves praise.

People were cracking on Mariah Carey for her latest album sales. It’s like… what more do y’all want from Mariah? Every Christmas for years she literally gives us herself and makes the holiday season bigger. What more do we want from these legends?

And when it’s time for Beyoncé to slow down or retire, y’all gonna give her the same smoke. Meanwhile Beyoncé is like Janet when it comes to touring. Perfectionists. Top-notch production. Precision. Do you know how much of yourself you have to give to produce shows like that? And then still try to make it flawless so critics don’t drag you? Because believe it or not, words hurt. Even when they act unbothered.

Honestly, I think the criticism is coming from a place of love. Y’all miss them. We miss them. What’s happening in music right now has a lot of people unhappy. So instead of shading the legends, maybe redirect that energy. Bring back gatekeepers. Because a lot of what’s on the airwaves right now is gimmicks, not talent.

You’ve got artists like Fantasia and Teyana Taylor talking about “last albums” when they shouldn’t even be near that conversation yet. But that’s what happens when quality isn’t being supported. All that’s being pushed is algorithm music. Two-minute songs. One verse. A bunch of hooks.

With the rise of initiation and crowd disruption in the current MLBB meta, Tigreal stands out as a reliable anchoring tank who excels at initiating fights, locking down enemies, and providing massive crowd control for his team.

📍 Overview
Strengths: Strong crowd control, excellent initiation, solid tankiness, teamfight disruption

⚙️ Recommended Build
• Warrior Boots – Movement speed and physical defense early to help with roaming and positioning
• Dominance Ice – Reduces enemy lifesteal and attack speed around you 
• Antique Cuirass – Reduces enemy physical damage and increases survivability
• Athena’s Shield – Magic resistance and shield to withstand burst damage 
• Immortality – Provides a second chance in critical teamfights 
• Guardian Helmet – Boosts HP and regen to stay longer in fights

🧬 Emblem & Spell
Emblem: Custom Tank
• Vitality → Extra durability
• Tenacity → Reduced control duration
- Concussive blast → Hp based AOE damage
Battle Spell: Flicker – For aggressive initiations and safer ult engages

🔁 Combo (Teamfight Initiation)
Flicker → Ultimate (Implosion) → Skill 2 (Sacred Hammer) → Skill 1 (Attack Wave)

💡 Tips
• Use Ultimate to pull enemies toward you to start or turn teamfights, setting up easy follow‑ups for your team
• Skill 2’s second phase knocks enemies airborne, which can interrupt key opponents and create openings 
• Skill 1 applies multiple slows making it useful for peel and chasing down fleeing enemies
• Time your Ultimate with Flicker or allied crowd control to maximize catch potential

⚠️ Counters
• High mobility assassins – Can dodge your crowd control and reach your backline before you set up
• Purify users – Can remove your stun chains reducing your initiation impact 
• Long‑range poke mages/marksmen – Can whittle you and your team before you engage 
• Heroes with cleanse or immunity buffs – Makes catching them with your crowd control harder

Lennox Lewis won a war with Shannon Briggs by 5th round TKO as he defended the WBC heavyweight title and won the lineal title at the Boardwalk Convention Center in Atlantic City, New Jersey #OnThisDay in 1998.

Lewis regained the title he lost to Oliver McCall and looked to make his third defense. Briggs, who similarly had only one loss at that point, won the lineal title with a controversial decision win over George Foreman in his previous fight. 

To his credit, Briggs came ready to fight. The first few rounds were a challenge for Lewis, who was briefly rocked and forced to turn away a charging Briggs.

A good jab and some right hands from Lewis changed the momentum in the 3rd round. Briggs went into the next round with a bloody mouth and it only got worse. Lewis' combinations broke through Briggs' guard and he finally went down. Briggs rose in bad shape as the bell rang.

In round 5, Briggs was all but done energy-wise. He absorbed more shots before a right hand put him down again and he got up at the count of eight. When Briggs swung and missed a punch that sent him to the canvas, the fight was stopped as he rose.

"He was a game fighter," Lewis said. "That's because I made it personal. He was braver than I expected. He did a lot of talking during the week, so he had to back it up. That's why he got up off the canvas three times. I knew my defense was too good for him."

"I wasn't at my best," Briggs said. "I wanted to use the whole ring and counter. His range was better than I expected. Lennox didn't hit as hard as George [Foreman], but he was not far behind in power."

"Sugar" Ray Leonard followed up on the "No Mas" fiasco by defending the WBC welterweight title with a 10th round TKO of Larry Bonds at the Carrier Dome in Syracuse, New York #OnThisDay in 1981.

Leonard already had junior middleweight champion Ayub Kalule lined up, with most acknowledging it was likely an attempt to boost his bargaining power against fellow welterweight Thomas Hearns. Bonds was a southpaw who worked as a garbage collector and reportedly already wanted to retire. The fight was seen as a tune-up for the Kalule fight, especially since Kalule was also a southpaw.

"My kids still want me to win," Bonds said before the bout. "I told them that if I won, I'd take them to Disneyland."

In front of about 21,000 fans, Bonds made himself difficult to hit at times, and Leonard looked desperate and wild missing punches. Bonds hit the deck in round 4 before surviving into the later rounds. In the 10th round, a right hand rocked Bonds and a follow up sent him down. He beat the count, but he was only punished more before the fight was stopped.

An annoyed Ray Leonard said, "They said I had no business fighting this guy, and then when I didn't stop him, they booed. I think that was an injustice to me and to Larry Bonds. But I learned one thing: to be myself. And I learned not to believe the press when they say the other guy is a pushover."

Bonds made $100,000, much more than the career-high $1,500 purse he made before fighting Leonard, whose purse was $750,000.

Today we honor “the Streak”

The Cornell Lacrosse teams from 1976, 1977, and 1978 accomplished one of the greatest feats ever achieved by a collegiate lacrosse program – an NCAA record 42-game winning streak that stretched nearly three full seasons.

During that stretch, the Big Red won two national championships, were ranked No. 1 in the USILA coaches poll for 14 consecutive weeks, and defeated its opponents by an astounding margin of 9.8 goals per game.

These teams laid the foundation for today’s program. They will be recognized on Schoellkopf Field today during halftime.

The original B&M…

Ralph Brand and Jimmy Millar — two names that still echo round Ibrox. Proper old-school partnership, lethal in front of goal and a nightmare for any defence put in front of them.

Between them they rattled in over 300 goals in their time at Rangers, with Brand hitting 206 and Millar 162. But it’s no just the numbers — it was the understanding, the movement, the way they linked up like they’d been playing together their whole lives.

Early 60s they were unplayable. Big goals, big moments, cup finals, league runs — they delivered the lot. Millar banging in goals for fun, Brand right there beside him, both of them tearing through teams week in, week out. Defenders all over Scotland (and Europe) knew what was coming and still couldnae stop it.

And when it came to the big games, especially against Celtic, they turned it up another level. Millar’s record speaks for itself, Brand chipping in as well — proper derby players.

What makes it even better? They went on to link up again down south at Derby County. Different strip, same understanding, same problem for defenders.

That’s what you call a partnership.

Appreciation post circa August 🚨 I can’t believe I forgot to post these! 🫢 The new center hub to my recording rig.

This is the 8MX2 🔴 from ATI (Audio Toys Inc.) The company that once owned API, and in a twist of audio lore, the API name eventually eclipsed ATI. Some may know ATI from their Paragon audio consoles. This box carries that lineage.

8 mic preamps w/ limiters + 8 channels of analog summing with a stereo mix out > all in one box. ‼️ Insane flexibility, headroom for days and MASSIVE sound.

My end goal was to find a unit that provided maximum mobility and actually gave me a sound that I liked. This was it. ✅ For extra color, I patch in my CAPI transformer boxes when I want it.

**There’s a reason why Taylor Swift had a rack of these on tour for recording live shows.

Kelihaian Makro, Team Liquid ID Tumbangkan NAVI 2-1 dalam Duel Taktis Sengit di MPL ID Season 17!

Hai, MedForians!

Match kelima MPL Indonesia Season 17 baru saja menjadi saksi bisu pertarungan kelas tinggi antara Team Liquid ID (TLID) melawan NAVI. 

Laga ini bukan sekadar adu mekanik biasa, melainkan sebuah pertempuran strategi yang menyerupai permainan catur, di mana penguasaan peta dan filosofi draf menjadi kunci utama kemenangan.

TLID berhasil mengunci kemenangan setelah melalui seri pertandingan yang sangat intens. Pada ronde pertama, TLID menunjukkan pertahanan solid melalui permainan hero Lylia dari Drichel yang sukses menciptakan zona aman selama 23 menit. Meski NAVI sempat menyamakan kedudukan di ronde kedua berkat kelihaian Yi Sun-Shin milik Andoryuuu, TLID terbukti lebih adaptif.

Pada ronde penentu, penggunaan hero Zetian oleh TLID menjadi pembeda. Kemampuan memberikan efek kejut dan kelihaian memantau peta berhasil membutakan pergerakan lini belakang pemain NAVI. Drichel yang tampil sebagai otak taktis tim dinobatkan sebagai pemain paling bernilai (MVP), didampingi performa mematikan Kyouu dengan hero Moskov yang sangat klinis di posisi Gold Lane.

Pertandingan ini membuktikan bahwa di meta saat ini, kemampuan adaptasi strategi dan kontrol informasi di dalam peta jauh lebih berharga daripada sekadar agresivitas. Fleksibilitas draf serta eksekusi makro yang sempurna akhirnya membawa Team Liquid ID keluar sebagai pemenang dalam duel bergengsi ini.

Bagaimana pendapat MedForians mengenai performa draf dari Team Liquid ID kali ini?

The lineup of Tartarus started with a vision, they stumbled, fell and got back up again. The journey was not easy but the boys were resilient. Joseph, Kyle, Eden, 27 & Kimyy,  are now going to carry on and continue on their own path forward, although not with Tartarus anymore they were a part of the history of Tartarus and we wish them the best of luck and all success across all their future endeavours. 

The goal of Tartarus has always been to find a diamond in the rough and polish them for the world to see as we have done not only with this lineup but also with our previous members and talents as well who are currently thriving in the ML esports scenario. 

It is now time to embark on a new journey to find more such individuals and players for whom an ecosystem is built to thrive and shine under the spotlight when put on them. 

As Tartarus now enters the next phase with a new project in mind. We need your support now more than ever as having the Indian talents reach a higher level only helps making sure the ML esports scenario does not stay stagnant. 

So tell me, who’s next?

Intriguing and revealing, this book offers a unique perspective on the behind-the-scenes dynamics of hip-hop’s evolution, exploring the intricate connections between artists, their personas, and the challenges faced in the pursuit of creative freedom and success. 

The book delves into the intricate relationship between The Don, and Tupac Shakur, exploring the creation of the Thug Life Theory and its impact on the hip-hop genre. Revealing the behind-the-scenes dynamics, the narrative uncovers the roots of conflict between Tupac and The Notorious B.I.G., shedding light on the author’s challenging upbringing and journey into the music industry.

The Don’s role in shaping Tupac’s persona, Thug Life Theory, and influencing other prominent artists like Biggie, Jay Z, Nas, Dr. Dre, and Snoop Dogg is a central theme. The book highlights The Don’s stipulations for Tupac’s success, including maintaining anonymity, supporting inner-city kids, and adhering to the Thug Life Theory Codex.
The book 2PACOLOGY THE ARTIST delves into the complexities of Tupac’s career and the behind-the-scenes It sheds light on the challenges, betrayals, and obstacles that Tupac faced, as well as the strategic planning and creative partnership that drove his success.

After researching the 1953 Waco Tornado, I discovered that Waco’s Cameron Park is a hotbed for paranormal activity and urban legends! The first one, I want to share is the legend about Cameron Park Road and the Seven Sisters.

Cameron Park Road has a twisting route with seven sharp turns between Lovers’ Leap and Jacob’s Ladder (both special interest points in the park). The legend goes that if you drive at night and say the name of each of the seven sisters at every bend in the road then the Seven Sisters will appear to you. 

There’s something extraordinary about this legend: it’s a traveling legend. A traveling urban legend means that another similar legend sprang up in a completely different place. The other place is Nebraska, just south of Nebraska City. This Seven Sisters road (known as L Street on maps) has a similar story. A young man with seven sisters has a horrible argument with his parents. He murders his seven sisters and hangs each one from a tree along with winding road. The legend goes if you drive along that stretch of road at night, your car will have mechanical issues, you might see shadowy figures along the side of the road, and you may even hear voices as the wind picks up. 

The two legends belong to a large group of legends: the Beware Road legends. Roads represent freedom of movement, but they also represent leaving the safety and security of home. The Beware Road Legends all try to explain the paranormal events that occur along roads. They warn travels to “Be Ware” as they travel. 

What urban legend or cryptid would you like to hear about next?
Please share this with your friends and let them get a taste of the world of Urban Legends!

🌊 Song-Kul: the space where sadness loosens its grip.

There are days when sadness does not look dramatic, yet it quietly drains everything. You still move, talk, work, but inside there is a dim weight, like a low sky that never lifts. Song-Kul is often remembered for exactly this state. It is a high-altitude lake on a wide plateau where the horizon is so open that your mind stops pressing against walls. The landscape feels like a clean page: water, wind, grass, and a sky that seems to sit closer than usual.

✍️ Locals and experienced travelers usually say the same thing: do not arrive and “do something” immediately. First, walk along the shore without a goal. Let your breathing match the rhythm of your steps. Notice the way the wind changes when you turn your body. Then approach the water slowly and pause at the edge. Some people step in only to the ankles. Others just wet their palms and touch their forehead. The point is not endurance. The point is contact. This simple cold touch often breaks the inner loop and returns the feeling of being present.

After Song-Kul, people often describe a quiet shift. Not a sudden happiness, but a steady lightness. Sleep becomes deeper. The body feels less guarded. Thoughts stop clinging. 

If you expected a dramatic emotional release and did not get it, there is nothing to fear. Sometimes the real result is simply that the heaviness stopped growing, and that is already a return to yourself.

Welcome Sa MPL Indonesia, Kelra! ONIC ID Bantai Alter Ego 2-0 Tanpa Balas

Hai, MedForians!

Dominasi tim landak kuning masih sulit dibendung. Pertandingan Match 4 MPL ID Season 17 menjadi saksi ketangguhan ONIC saat berhadapan dengan Alter Ego. Fokus utama tertuju pada Kelra yang melakoni debutnya di panggung kompetisi kasta tertinggi Indonesia dengan performa yang sangat efisien.

Pada gim pertama, ONIC menerapkan strategi agresif untuk merusak skema late-game milik Alter Ego. Kiboy yang menggunakan Chou tampil solid sebagai barisan depan, memberikan ruang aman bagi Kairi dan Kelra untuk melakukan farming. Kelra yang menggunakan Yi Sun-shin berhasil mencatatkan KDA 6/0/8, sekaligus memberikan visi bagi timnya agar tidak terjebak dalam jebakan lawan.

Masuk ke gim kedua, Alter Ego mencoba membalas dengan komposisi hero lincah seperti Joy dan Suyou. Namun, strategi "Protect the Castle" dari ONIC terbukti sangat kokoh. SANZ yang menggunakan Gord menjadi mesin penghancur dengan catatan damage tertinggi mencapai 64.683. Tanpa adanya hero tank murni di sisi Alter Ego, serangan laser dari Gord dengan mudah menguras nyawa lawan sebelum mereka sempat melakukan inisiasi.

Kemenangan mutlak 2-0 ini membuktikan bahwa proses adaptasi Kelra ke dalam sistem permainan ONIC berjalan sangat mulus. Sebaliknya, Alter Ego harus segera mengevaluasi transisi permainan mereka agar tidak mudah terkena efek snowballing dari tim lawan di pertandingan mendatang.

Sekretaris Majalengka Korupsi?
Gian Gandana Sukma (MGS), yang menjabat sebagai Sekretaris Desa Cipaku, kini berstatus tersangka oleh Kejaksaan Negeri Majalengka terkait dugaan penyelewengan dana desa tahun anggaran 2025.
MGS diduga mengalihkan dana sebesar Rp513,6 juta dari rekening desa ke rekening miliknya. Dana itu kemudian dipakai untuk membeli diamond di permainan Mobile Legends. Saat ini, MGS telah ditahan selama 20 hari di Lapas Kelas II B Majalengka untuk proses hukum lebih lanjut.
“Kami telah memeriksa tersangka dan langsung melakukan penahanan selama 20 hari ke depan,” ujar Kasi Pidsus Kejari Majalengka, Hendra Prayog, pada Kamis (3/7/2025).

Legends - Volumen 1

Una lista así no es solo una recopilación… es una línea temporal que respira música.

Desde la revolución melódica de The Beatles y The Rolling Stones, pasando por la elegancia sonora de Fleetwood Mac o Dire Straits, hasta la épica emocional de U2 y el pulso contemporáneo de finales de los 90… esta selección recorre cuatro décadas donde el pop y el rock no solo evolucionaron, sino que definieron generaciones.

Cada canción funciona como un punto en el mapa: 
una guitarra que abrió camino, una voz que marcó época, un estribillo que aún sigue vivo.

Las playlists, más que agrupar canciones, construyen identidad y reflejan gustos y momentos personales, convirtiéndose en auténticos retratos musicales del tiempo (arXiv) 

Aquí no hay nostalgia vacía. 
Hay historia, energía y canciones que siguen sonando como si nunca se hubieran ido.

🎧 100 temas. 40 años. Un mismo hilo conductor: el sonido que nunca dejó de avanzar. #legends #rockandroll #hits

Draft yang berfokus pada Hard-CC Chain dan serangan agresif terbukti ampuh meredam agresivitas Geek Fam. Dengan stabilitas yang dihadirkan para pemain baru dan kebebasan Alberttt untuk mengeksekusi peluang, EVOS Esports kini menjadi ancaman serius bagi tim lain di musim ini.

Another Topps Classic design that I wish they would bring back, these cards were masterpieces. Not only do you get two autos of the fighters from the main event but you get an actual mat relic from that particular fight. It’s difficult to top these kinds of cards and I believe there’s been so many missed opportunities over the years where some classic fights could’ve really benefited from these types of cards. Can you imagine for example this card with Robbie Lawler and Rory MacDonald with the fight mat relic from their UFC 189 classic? 🤯

I really do think a ball was dropped somewhere along the way in the hobby with these types of cards. They had so many great designs and unique ideas in the early sets but they seem to fall by the wayside and then before we knew it we got overloaded with Prizm parallels. Nothing against the people who favour those types of cards but personally I’d much rather have something like this with a meaningful relic from the fight to stir up those memories. For me that’s a big part of what being a collector is about and I love the feeling I can get from looking at a certain card.

This one in particular was amazing as we saw Chuck Liddell put an exclamation point on his trilogy with Randy Couture. After a shock loss to Couture in the first meeting between the two fighters, Liddell came back strong in the second fight KO’ing The Natural in the 1st round to even the odds. In this final encounter between the two, it took The Iceman one round longer but the result was the same as the second as he KO’d Randy to defend his title and continue his light heavyweight dominance.

It might be a long shot but I’d love to see these types of cards being made again 🙌 #ufc #mma #legends #collection #cards

🏆 Before the Rings… There Was the Lesson!
In 2007, a young LeBron James carried the Cleveland Cavaliers to the NBA Finals — far earlier than anyone expected. Just 22 years old, facing a dynasty led by Tim Duncan and the battle-tested San Antonio Spurs.
The stage was massive. The moment was overwhelming.
And the Spurs showed what championship experience looked like, completing a sweep and capturing another title.
But the most powerful moment didn’t happen during the games.
After the series, Duncan approached LeBron with respect — not as a defeated opponent, but as a future legend — and told him:
“This league is going to be yours someday.”
(Often remembered as: “You’ll be back here.”)
It wasn’t sympathy.
It was recognition.
A veteran champion seeing greatness before the world fully understood it.
That loss didn’t define LeBron — it forged him. Years later, he returned stronger, wiser, and eventually fulfilled the prophecy, turning heartbreak into championships and building one of the greatest careers the game has ever seen.
Sometimes the first Finals isn’t about winning the title…

The metric was green.
The product was hurting people.

Facebook Lite set DAU as its North Star — same as core Facebook.

Six months in: DAU looked fine. But Lite users in rural India were burning through their entire weekly mobile data budget on video autoplay.

A metric built for one user, applied to a completely different one, can actively cause harm.

FLOW breakdown:

F — Frame: Lite users are on low-end phones with 512MB RAM and metered data. DAU was built for users on reliable WiFi.
L — List: Mirror core metrics? Session count + offline rate? Weekly Active Returners?
O — Optimize: Weekly cadence matches real usage bursts. A session that drops mid-load isn't a success.
W — Win: Weekly Active Returners as the North Star. Guardrail: session completion rate > 65% in target markets.
