सीमा देव या हिंदी आणि मराठी चित्रपटसृष्टीतील अत्यंत देखण्या, सोज्वळ आणि बहुआयामी अभिनेत्री म्हणून ओळखल्या जातात. सहा दशकांहून अधिक काळाच्या त्यांच्या कारकिर्दीत त्यांनी “Prem Patra,” “Anand,” “Koshish,” “Kora Kagaz” यांसारख्या अनेक गाजलेल्या चित्रपटांत काम करून प्रेक्षकांच्या मनावर कायमची छाप सोडली.
२७ मार्च १९४२ रोजी मुंबईतील गिरगाव येथे नलिनी सराफ या नावाने त्यांचा जन्म झाला. कर्नाटकातून आलेल्या गौड सारस्वत ब्राह्मण कुटुंबात त्या वाढल्या. वडिलांच्या अकाली निधनानंतर घरची आर्थिक परिस्थिती खालावली आणि त्यामुळे लहान वयातच त्यांना चित्रपटसृष्टीत पाऊल ठेवावे लागले. एका ओळखीच्या व्यक्तीच्या सल्ल्याने त्या आईसोबत फिल्मिस्तान स्टुडिओत गेल्या, जिथे त्यांची भेट अभिनेते रमेश देव यांच्याशी झाली. सुरुवातीला त्यांच्या आईला रमेश देव खलनायक वाटत असल्याने ती त्यांच्याशी बोलू देत नव्हती, पण रमेश देव यांनी आपल्या साधेपणाने तिची समजूत काढली.
१९५७ साली “Aaliya Bhogasi” या चित्रपटातून त्यांना पहिली संधी मिळाली आणि याच चित्रपटात त्यांचे नाव सीमा सराफ असे ठेवण्यात आले. पुढे १९६० साली “Jagachya Pathivar” या मराठी चित्रपटातून त्यांना प्रमुख भूमिका मिळाली. त्याच वर्षी त्यांनी “Miya Bibi Razi” या चित्रपटातून हिंदी चित्रपटसृष्टीत पदार्पण केले.
मराठी आणि हिंदी दोन्ही चित्रपटांत त्यांनी अनेक दर्जेदार भूमिका साकारल्या. १९६३ साली त्यांनी रमेश देव यांच्याशी विवाह केला आणि ही जोडी चित्रपटसृष्टीतील आदर्श दांपत्य म्हणून प्रसिद्ध झाली. “Anand” मधील त्यांची भूमिका विशेष गाजली.
त्यांना अजिंक्य आणि अभिनय असे दोन पुत्र आहेत, ज्यांनीही चित्रपटसृष्टीत आपला ठसा उमटवला. आयुष्याच्या उत्तरार्धात त्यांना Alzheimer’s आजार झाला. २४ ऑगस्ट २०२३ रोजी त्यांचे निधन झाले. त्यांच्या अभिनयाची समृद्ध परंपरा आणि आठवणी आजही प्रेक्षकांच्या मनात जिवंत आहेत.#marathimanoranjan #seemadeo #legends @ajinkkyadeo

el jueves 5 de mayo, Juan Manuel emitió el siguiente comunicado “Aún estoy bajo la fuerte impresión que me ocasionó la trágica desaparición de mi gran amigo Ayrton Senna.
​“Los que alguna vez vivimos sobre las pistas de carrera del mundo, sabemos que estos riesgos existen y son las reglas del juego. Obviamente, no deja de causarnos un gran dolor cuando perdemos compañeros de ruta y hombres que siguen el camino del automovilismo.
​“Senna era un joven brillante. Muchas veces nos hemos sentado a charlar acerca de nuestra profesión y debo decir que nuestro respeto era mutuo. Yo admiraba a Ayrton Senna, lo admiro y seguirá siendo para mí un hombre íntegro que sabía lo que hacía.
​“La muerte de mi amigo me causa un gran dolor. Sólo puedo imaginar que Ayrton Senna eligió la manera de irse.” 🇦🇷🤝🏻🇧🇷

 Easy-E's passing in 1995 marked a tremendous loss for the rap community and the music industry as a whole. He was not only a trailblazer in the gangsta rap genre but also a founder of N.W.A, which revolutionized hip-hop and brought crucial social issues to the forefront. His unique style and voice contributed to the success of many iconic tracks that still resonate today. 

In addition, his battle with AIDS brought attention to a disease that was often stigmatized and misunderstood. Easy-E's openness about his health struggle may have helped break the silence around HIV/AIDS, encouraging conversations that were desperately needed at the time. His legacy lives on through his music, which continues to inspire and influence new generations of artists. Let’s remember his contributions not just for what he achieved, but for the impact he made on society and the awareness he raised. 🌟 What are your favorite Easy-E tracks?

Tim Hardaway con la anécdota de cómo hizo el acercamiento a Alonzo Mourning para que Pat Riley cambiara por él y tener su redención en Miami. 
 
 Tim Hardaway arrasó en la NBA, pero cuando se perdió toda la temporada 1993-94 debido a una grave lesión en la rodilla, los Golden State Warriors desconfiaron pensando que lo peor podría pasar.

▪️ “Le dije a Zo que le dijera a Pat: ‘Necesitas un armador como yo para que venga y dirija este equipo’, y sé que puedo hacerlo.  Le dije a Zo: 'Dile que cambie por mí y lo llegaremos a los playoffs'. No sé si [Riley] me creyó o no.  Solo creo que dijo: 'Qué diablos, déjame intentarlo, porque en este momento, no va a suceder'", dijo Hardaway al South Florida Sun Sentinel el año pasado.
 
 En ese momento, Hardaway tenía todas las razones para dejar Golden State.  Los días del Run TMC habían terminado, su papel se había reducido drásticamente y los Warriors estaban luchando tremendamente para llegar a la postemporada.

 El 22 de febrero de 1996, un asombroso intercambio de 10 jugadores finalmente hizo que Hardaway fuera enviado al Heat.  Tres días después, hizo su debut para Riley, y el hombre en cuestión actuó como se anunciaba.

 Zo, Hardaway y Riley instantáneamente hicieron clic cuando el Heat se convirtió en contendientes constantes a los playoffs en el Este. En su primer partido con el Heat, Tim Hardaway demostró que no se había sobrevendido.

2. Measure Length & Width: Start from one end and measure across to the other end for the length. For width, measure from the wall (including backsplash) to the front edge of the countertop. Remember, precision is key!
3. Don't Forget Special Features: If you have a sink, oven, or any feature that interrupts the countertop space, measure these areas separately.

“Experimente estar estando…” 👇🏼

Existe um tipo de presença que raramente praticamos. Não estou falando de fazer, resolver, antecipar ou corrigir. É só estar. Mas não um estar distraído, dividido e meio ausente. É um estar inteiro dentro do momento, mesmo quando o momento não tem nada de extraordinário.

A dificuldade começa porque fomos treinados a funcionar no automático. Enquanto o corpo está em um lugar, a mente corre para outro. Enquanto a vida acontece, tentamos controlá-la, ajustar, acelerar e até mesmo fugir…

Estar estando exige o contrário disso. Exige abrir mão do controle por alguns instantes e aceitar o que se apresenta, sem edição.

Isso incomoda. Porque quando você para de fugir, você encontra o que estava evitando. Talvez o silêncio ou o cansaço, também pode encontrar pensamentos bagunçados e até emoções que não cabem numa rotina organizada. 

Mas também é aí que algo muda. Quando você sustenta esse estado, sem tentar escapar, você começa a perceber nuances que antes passavam despercebidas.

Estar estando não é passividade. É atenção. É escolher não se anestesiar com distrações o tempo todo. E permitir que um momento simples tenha profundidade suficiente para ser vivido por completo.

Talvez o maior desafio seja aceitar que nem todo instante precisa ser produtivo, interessante ou bonito. Alguns só precisam ser vividos. E isso, por mais simples que pareça, já transforma a forma como “atravessamos” o dia.
.
.
.

Sementara itu, di Cina, Moonton sendiri merilis Juesheng Dianfeng (决胜巅峰). Game ini sengaja disesuaikan dengan regulasi dan budaya Cina, mulai dari tampilan hero sampai sistem monetisasinya. Jadi, walaupun inti game-nya sama, pengalaman mainnya beda banget!

Kenapa bisa beda? Karena setiap negara punya regulasi dan preferensi pasarnya sendiri. Pengembang game harus pinter-pinter adaptasi biar game mereka bisa sukses di pasar global yang beragam.

AE Arfy Siap Buktikan Kualitas Melawan EMANN dan Kelra di MPL ID S17

Hai, MedForians!

Panggung MPL ID Season 17 segera dimulai dengan tema utama "Find the Formula". Alter Ego yang datang sebagai runner-up MPL ID S16 dan M7 World Championship disebut sebagai tim yang paling siap dengan komposisi roster yang solid. Ujian pertama mereka langsung hadir di pekan pembuka melalui duel panas "Derbi STM" melawan Bigetron by Vitality serta laga sengit kontra juara bertahan, ONIC Esports.

Sorotan utama tertuju pada sang gold laner, Arfy, yang akan langsung berhadapan dengan dua pemain hebat asal Filipina, EMANN dan Kelra. Meski harus melawan pemain kaliber dunia, Arfy mengaku sangat antusias dan penasaran, terutama untuk menghadapi Kelra yang baru saja memulai kariernya di Indonesia.

Arfy dikenal memiliki fleksibilitas tinggi dengan mampu memainkan hero Fighter di gold lane saat META berubah. 

Walaupun sering disebut sebagai "Gold Standard" baru, pemain bernama asli Arifudin Dingarai Putra ini tetap rendah hati. Baginya, predikat tersebut baru layak disandang jika ia sudah berhasil membawa pulang gelar juara.

Selain mengincar trofi domestik, Arfy juga menegaskan ambisinya untuk meraih kesuksesan di panggung internasional seperti Esports World Cup (EWC). Menarik untuk melihat bagaimana racikan strategi Coach Xepher dan eksekusi Arfy dalam meredam dominasi lawan di week 1 nanti.

Menurut MedForians, mampukah Arfy membuktikan dirinya lebih unggul dari EMANN dan Kelra di awal musim ini?

36-year-old "Sugar" Ray Robinson regained the middleweight championship the "Fight of the Year" with a 15 round split decision over Carmen Basilio at Chicago Stadium in Chicago, Illinois #OnThisDay in 1958.

Basilio and Robinson just had styles that clashed and made for close fights, as their first fight earlier suggested.

The champ successfully crowded Robinson until about round 5, when a right from Robinson began rapidly closing Basilio's eye. After that, Robinson got momentum on his side with jabs before he eventually lost steam.

Basilio didn't let and savagely attacked Robinson in several rounds. But the champion's eye looked terrible and he couldn't see Robinson's right hands sailing through his guard. Robinson hurt Basilio in three of the last five rounds, but he had trouble keeping his balance due to exhaustion. The crowd of roughly 18,000 went berserk as the fighters closed the fight strong.

Robinson had to be walked to his dressing room by his team, who barred press from entering and getting quotes.

"I just couldn't get my distance right after the eye closed," Basilio said. "I was off balance a lot of times. If you can't get distance, you find yourself off balance."

It was the second and final bout between the two, each taking one win apiece.

Heavyweight contender Larry Holmes earned a shot at the WBC heavyweight title with a commanding 12 round unanimous decision over Earnie Shavers at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas, Nevada #OnThisDay in 1978.

Holmes was then an undefeated and promising young heavyweight who was previously a sparring partner for Muhammad Ali and clearly learned a lot in camp with "The Greatest." It wasn't clear yet just how good he was, and he needed a challenge like Shavers to keep him honest.

A ringside report said:

"Holmes was brilliant in his victory over Shavers in the 12-round bout at Caesar's Palace.

His biggest problem was his trunks. They split down the middle of the seat in the second round and between the fourth and fifth rounds, his cornermen huddling around him, Holmes changed into a new pair. 
He had no problems the rest of the way against Shavers, a puncher who is a threat until the final round."

There were a few tense moments when Shavers occasionally got Holmes to the ropes and threatened to land something big, but Holmes generally had his way.

"I just fought the toughest man I ever fought," Holmes said. "He hits harder than Norton, I feel. He does punch hard, but I can take a good punch."

Memphis Memories: In 1978 the Memphis-Press Scimitar interviewed Memphis State Professor Everett Sutter about strange legends in Memphis. One legend surrounded a mysterious figure known as the Pig Man of Shelby Forest. The legend says that a man was driving through Shelby Forest and had a horrible car accident that killed his family. The accident disfigured the man giving him facial scars that made his image ‘pig like’. Traumatized by the loss of his family the ‘Pig Man’ ran into the woods where he still resides in seclusion.

ওয়ার্ল্ড চ্যাম্পিয়নশিপ অব লিজেন্ডসে খেলবেন  আশরাফুল ও মাহমুদউল্লাহ রিয়াদ 

সাবেক তারকা ক্রিকেটারদের নিয়ে আয়োজিত ওয়ার্ল্ড চ্যাম্পিয়নশিপ অব লিজেন্ডসের (ডব্লিউসিএল) তৃতীয় আসরে অংশ নিতে যাচ্ছে বাংলাদেশ। ভারত, পাকিস্তান, অস্ট্রেলিয়া, নিউজিল্যান্ড, ওয়েস্ট ইন্ডিজ ও দক্ষিণ আফ্রিকার মতো শক্তিশালী দলের সঙ্গে এবার লড়বে বাংলাদেশ চ্যাম্পিয়নস।
বাংলাদেশ জাতীয় দলের সাবেক দুই অধিনায়ক মোহাম্মদ আশরাফুল ও মাহমুদউল্লাহ রিয়াদ ওয়ার্ল্ড চ্যাম্পিয়নশিপ অব লিজেন্ডসে খেলার জন্য সম্মতি দিয়েছেন।
আয়োজকদের আশা, ২০২৬ আসরে বাংলাদেশের অন্তর্ভুক্তি এই টুর্নামেন্টের প্রতিযোগিতা ও উত্তেজনা আরো বাড়িয়ে তুলবে। এ নিয়ে ডব্লিউসিএলের প্রতিষ্ঠাতা ও প্রধান নির্বাহী হর্ষিত তোমার বলেছেন, ‘গত দুই বছর ধরে ভক্তদের থেকে যে পরিমাণ অনুরোধ এসেছে, তারই প্রেক্ষিতে এবার বাংলাদেশকে এই আসরে যুক্ত করার সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়া হয়েছে।’বাংলাদেশ চ্যাম্পিয়নস দলের পরিচালক ইউনূস হাসান বলেছেন, ‘এটি দেশ ও বিদেশের ভক্ত-সমর্থকদের জন্য একটি স্মরণীয় মুহূর্ত, যা ক্রিকেট কমিউনিটির মধ্যে সম্পর্ক আরো মজবুত করতে ভূমিকা রাখবে।’
দলের সহ-স্বত্বাধিকারী ইশতিয়াক সাদেক বলেছেন, ‘ডব্লিউসিএলে বাংলাদেশ চ্যাম্পিয়নস দলের অংশ হওয়াটা আমাদের জন্য বড় সম্মানের। এই টুর্নামেন্টকে কিংবদন্তি ক্রিকেটারদের বিশ্বকাপ হিসেবে বিবেচনা করা হয়, যার মাধ্যমে বাংলাদেশের ক্রিকেট নতুন উচ্চতায় পৌঁছাবে। আমরা বাংলাদেশের কিংবদন্তি ক্রিকেটারদের নিয়ে একটি শক্তিশালী স্কোয়াড গঠনের আশা করছি।’
ডব্লিউসিএলের প্রথম দুই আসরে চ্যাম্পিয়ন হয়েছেন ভারত চ্যাম্পিয়নস ও দক্ষিণ আফ্রিকা চ্যাম্পিয়নস। দুবারই রানার্স আপ হয়েছে পাকিস্তান চ্যাম্পিয়নস। 
আগের দুবারের মতো এবারো ডব্লিউসিএল হওয়ার কথা ইংল্যান্ডের বার্মিংহামে। টুর্নামেন্ট শুরু হওয়ার কথা ১৮ জুলাই, ফাইনাল ২ আগস্ট।

💔 Broken Heart Rock (Jeti-Oguz)

After heartbreak, betrayal, or deep disappointment, people often try to harden themselves. The Broken Heart Rock offers a different message. The stone formation is visibly split, its fracture impossible to hide or smooth over. Visitors are drawn here when they are ready to acknowledge the break instead of denying it.

🏞️ Approaching the rock, many place a hand along the crack and pause. The practice here is not to relive the story, but to identify what remains unresolved: pain, fear of closeness, loss of trust. Then come three simple statements, formed quietly: what happened, what was learned, and how you wish to relate to love or connection from now on. These are not vows. They are acknowledgements.

People often leave this place feeling clearer rather than lighter. The pain may still exist, but it no longer dominates. 

And if what you feel is clarity instead of relief, there is nothing to fear. Clarity is often the first real step toward healing.

🔸️River Wye
🌍 Wales 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁷󠁬󠁳󠁿

📸 No filter

The River Wye in Wales is rich in folklore, much of it tied to ancient myths and legendary tales. 

▫️The Three Sisters of Plynlimon: A central legend tells of three water spirits—Wye, Ystwyth, and Severn—born from the tears of a sleeping giant, Mount Plynlimon, in the Cambrian Mountains.  Each sister chose a different path to the sea: Ystwyth took the shortest route west to Cardigan Bay, Severn journeyed slowly through towns and cities, and Wye chose a scenic, meandering path through the lush valleys and forests of Mid Wales, captivated by the beauty of the land. 

▫️The Mordiford Dragon: Near the village of Mordiford, a green dragon is said to have lived at the confluence of the River Wye and River Lugg. Raised by a young girl named Maud, the dragon grew too large for milk and began attacking farms.  After a battle, a local man from the Garstone family killed it, leaving Maud heartbroken. 

▫️The Devil’s Pulpit: This rocky outcrop near Tintern Abbey is said to be where the Devil once tried to preach to monks, hoping to tempt them from their faith.  According to legend, the monks outsmarted him by dousing him with Holy Water, forcing him to flee. 

▫️The Ghostly Figures of Swan Pool: On the road to Newland near Redbrook, a ghostly woman carrying a child and a phantom dog are said to appear at Swan Pool, their haunting presence accompanied by a baby’s cry.

These tales reflect the deep cultural and spiritual significance of the River Wye, blending nature, myth, and history in the Welsh landscape.

🏰 Turaida Castle Grounds and the Grave of the Rose of Turaida

When relationships feel fragile, fear often hides behind ordinary words. A small conflict suddenly feels like a threat. Distance feels larger. Trust feels easy to lose and hard to rebuild. Even in loving relationships, a person may quietly worry: “Will we last,” “Do we value the same things,” “Can we stay loyal in real life, not only in good moments?” At those times, people seek not romance, but steadiness. A reminder that devotion can be strong, clean, and durable.

Visitors come to the grave with flowers, often light-colored, as a symbol of sincere intention. The best time is when the grounds are calm: morning on a weekday, or late afternoon when crowds thin out. The approach matters: walk slowly, let your breathing settle, and avoid turning the visit into a performance. At the grave, people stand in silence for a few minutes. They do not ask for a perfect relationship. Instead, they focus on three quiet statements: what they are grateful for in their partner, what they want to protect in the bond, and what they personally are willing to do to strengthen it. Some leave the flowers and then step back, staying in silence a little longer, as if letting the intention “sink in.”

✍️ Many report a softening inside: less suspicion, less defensive thinking, more willingness to speak honestly. In the following days, communication often becomes clearer because the emotional temperature lowers. Even if problems remain, they feel workable rather than fatal. 

And if nothing changes overnight, there is nothing to fear. Deep loyalty is not a switch. It is a practice, and this place is used as a quiet anchor for that practice.

THE BISTERNE DRAGON & SIR MAURICE BERKELEY 

🐉There was bred in Hampshire a devouring Dragon who dwelt in its lair upon Burley Beacon. He was a huge, foul-tempered beast, who would regularly terrorise the village of Bisterne, breathing fire and demanding pails of milk and the flesh of cattle. 🐮

🛡️ Maddened at the plight of the village, the elders asked for the assistance of Sir Maurice de Berkeley who, together with his hunting dogs named Grim and Holdfast, set about to slay the dragon. 

⚔️ The encounter began in ‘Dragon Fields’ at Lower Bisterne Farm, and the adversaries circled around the boundaries of the whole Forest engaged in a long and deadly battle. The Dragon breathed fire in every direction, burning great swathes of gorse and heath. The battle wore on for several days, and the exhausted Sir Maurice de Berkeley became more desperate - it is even said that he covered his armour with shards of broken glass, and offered himself up as an appetiser to the creature, wounding the beast mercilessly as it bit down onto him. 

🌳 Eventually, our hero overcame the beast and the wounded Dragon came crashing down in Lyndhurst, at a place known today as Boltons Bench. Here, the Dragon was slain, the arch of its back creating the hill at the centre of the green. 

🏹 Although victorious, the battle left Sir Maurice de Berkeley a broken man, and he died at the Dragons’ side. His yew-wood bow slipped from his hand and began to spring roots into the earth of the Forest, sprouting the Yew trees which grow on top of Boltons Bench today.

THE BISTERNE DRAGON & SIR MAURICE BERKELEY 

🐉There was bred in Hampshire a devouring Dragon who dwelt in its lair upon Burley Beacon. He was a huge, foul-tempered beast, who would regularly terrorise the village of Bisterne, breathing fire and demanding pails of milk and the flesh of cattle. 🐮

🛡️ Maddened at the plight of the village, the elders asked for the assistance of Sir Maurice de Berkeley who, together with his hunting dogs named Grim and Holdfast, set about to slay the dragon. 

⚔️ The encounter began in ‘Dragon Fields’ at Lower Bisterne Farm, and the adversaries circled around the boundaries of the whole Forest engaged in a long and deadly battle. The Dragon breathed fire in every direction, burning great swathes of gorse and heath. The battle wore on for several days, and the exhausted Sir Maurice de Berkeley became more desperate - it is even said that he covered his armour with shards of broken glass, and offered himself up as an appetiser to the creature, wounding the beast mercilessly as it bit down onto him. 

🌳 Eventually, our hero overcame the beast and the wounded Dragon came crashing down in Lyndhurst, at a place known today as Boltons Bench. Here, the Dragon was slain, the arch of its back creating the hill at the centre of the green. 

🏹 Although victorious, the battle left Sir Maurice de Berkeley a broken man, and he died at the Dragons’ side. His yew-wood bow slipped from his hand and began to spring roots into the earth of the Forest, sprouting the Yew trees which grow on top of Boltons Bench today.

In my heart, I knew this day would come. People said I was crazy, but I had to follow my dream.

Now, after countless hours and exhausting amounts of emotional, spiritual, and yes, financial sacrifice, my lifelong dream of the last several weeks has come true:

I own* the Skipping Stone Bow.

There were times where it felt impossible. Somewhere between returning from vacation, my daughter getting accepted to kindergarten, a major professional and personal accomplishment, and not sleeping for what I believe medical experts would describe as “too long,” I began to doubt myself.

Not about any of those other things, obviously.
Those are all nice.
But this was bigger.

There were dark moments. Moments where I questioned why Yotei and its RNG had abandoned me. I still can’t answer that question.

What I do know is that at one point, in a decision that can only be described as visionary, I literally purchased a PlayStation Portal so that I could continue this grind while on vacation. Some will call that irresponsible. I call it commitment.

And so, in this brief pause between meaningful real-world events that I will apparently not be posting about at this time, I am proud to share the achievement that matters most.

Please respect my family’s privacy as we process this miracle together. And be sure to join me in celebration on PSN.

*as much as one can own an in-game digital item.

Unlocking the Secrets of Jealousy: Myth or Truth? 💚🔑

Ever feel a twinge of jealousy in your relationship? You’re not alone! But before you let those green-eyed monster vibes take over, let’s dive into the truth about jealousy and how it can transform your connections for the better. 👀✨

✨ Myth: Jealousy Is Love – Many of us think jealousy is a sign of love, but more often it’s rooted in insecurity rather than affection. Healthy love flourishes on trust, not possessiveness. A secure relationship nurtures freedom and independence! 🌱❤️

📣 Truth: Sharing Is Caring – Openly discussing feelings around jealousy creates a safe space for both partners to share insecurities. When you talk it out, you lay the groundwork for a trust-filled relationship instead of letting it fester! 💬 

🚫 Beware of Control – Letting jealousy run unchecked? It could morph into controlling behaviors that can poison your bond. Strong partnerships promote autonomy while uplifting each other for personal growth. Let’s prioritize healthy boundaries! 🙌🌼

💞 Communication Is Key – Fantastic communication about jealousy allows you to tackle its underlying issues. Engaging in healthy dialogue brings understanding, helping you both avoid misunderstandings that can lead to conflict. Talk it out! 💬✨ 

🔑 Trust Takes Time – Remember, trust is built over time. In an environment rife with jealousy, it’s nearly impossible to foster genuine trust. Commit to open conversations and consistent actions to cultivate a trust-rich atmosphere! 🕰️💖 

So, the next time jealousy creeps in, remember these truths and transform it into an opportunity for growth. Share this with someone who might need to hear it today! 🥰

caption:
⚡🐉 THE ETERNAL CLASH: PERUN vs VELES 🌲🔥

Before kingdoms rose… before chronicles were written…
there was a war that shaped the world itself.

In the skies above, Perun—god of thunder, lightning, and war—stood as the defender of order. Armed with his mighty axe, hammer, or spear, he hurled bolts of lightning across the heavens. A grey-haired warrior with a golden moustache, he was the patron of warriors and the legendary druzhina.

But below… in the shadowed roots of the world… waited his eternal rival.

Veles—the chthonic god of the underworld, wealth, magic, and mystery.
A shapeshifter, a trickster, a guide of souls.
He ruled the realm of the dead, guarded cattle and riches, and inspired poets, artists, and sorcerers alike.
He could appear as a serpent, a dragon, or a great horned beast.

🐂🐍

The myth tells of an endless cycle:

Veles rises from the underworld, stealing cattle, wealth—or even the divine order itself.
Perun answers with thunder.

⚡ Lightning strikes the earth.
🌧 Storms rage across the sky.
🔥 Chaos meets fury.

Their battle is not just a fight—
it is the rhythm of nature itself.

Rain follows thunder.
Life follows death.
Order follows chaos.

And so, the cycle continues… forever.

—

✨ This is not just a myth.
It is the ancient Slavic vision of the world—
a balance between sky and earth, storm and shadow, life and the beyond.

—

Future heavyweight champ Rocky Marciano nearly lost his undefeated record when he struggled to win a 10 round split decision over Roland La Starza at Madison Square Garden in New York #OnThisDay in 1950.

La Starza slowed the pace and boxed through early rounds, and Marciano tore and scraped at his opponent viciously when he could. Marciano took a few rounds to get momentum, but finally in round 4 he hurt and dropped La Starza, who was saved by the bell. Marciano had good rounds in the 7th and 8th, but he lost the latter on a low blow as he continued to go after his man.

By the end, Marciano had barely hung on to take the fight on points, and walked away with swollen, purple eyes, a cut over his eyebrow and a badly bleeding nose.

The consensus tale about this fight is that La Starza was robbed of a win, and some claim ringside observers agreed La Starza should have won. But La Starza's manager Jimmy DeAngelo focused his ire more on Marciano getting away with various fouls. Newspaper coverage from the Garden reported that the fight was close, with Marciano winning his rounds emphatically while hurting La Starza several times, and winning an understandable decision.

Steve McQueen: The King Of Cool

Il était un Rocker (quoique féru de Jazz) dans ses attitudes et son mode de vie : “Sex and Drugs and Whiskies: High Speed”… 

Steve McQueen, l’enfant terrible du 7ème art aussi bien de par ses rôles « d’antihéros » que les nombreuses et douloureuses frasques dont il est sorti très souvent indemne. 

Paddy McAloon et son groupe Prefab Sprout lui ont tenu un étonnant hommage en 1985, à travers le LP Steve McQueen en Europe ; et Two Wheels Good aux USA, à cause  des problèmes juridiques avec sa succession. 

“The King of Cool” comme on l’appelait a quitté la scène à l’âge de 50 ans. On le croyait pourtant immortel. 

Il aurait eu 96 ans ce jour.

Steve McQueen, The definition of cool: https://youtu.be/105q9fhTErs

Steve McQueen: The King of Cool

A born rebel with a need for speed, Steve McQueen embodied the Rock’n’Roll spirit—though he had a soft spot for Jazz. His lifestyle? Sex, drugs, whiskey, and full throttle.

The enfant terrible of cinema, McQueen redefined the antihero on screen while living just as recklessly off it. His countless close calls only added to the legend—he always seemed to walk away unscathed.

In 1985, Paddy McAloon and Prefab Sprout paid him the ultimate tribute with their album Steve McQueen—or Two Wheels Good in the U.S., thanks to legal wrangling with his estate.

Dubbed The King of Cool, McQueen left the stage at just 50. But for many, he still feels immortal.

Today, he would have turned 96.

[Langage des fleurs] Bouton d'or

Ce nom populaire désigne en réalité plusieurs espèces de renoncules.

En allemand, on surnomme le bouton d'or "fleur de beurre" et en anglais "bol de beurre", car ses pétales jaunes et brillants réfléchissent sur la peau une lumière qui évoque celle du beurre.

Rapporté en France par les croisés, le bouton d'or a toujours évoqué le luxe. 

Dans le langage des fleurs, il signifie : "Tu es radieuse et charmante, éblouissante, brillante". 

Une légende en raconte l'origine mythologique. Ranonculus était un beau jeune homme, toujours brillamment vêtu de jaune et de vert, doué d'une voix mélodieuse et charmante. Un jour qu'il chantait pour un groupe de  nymphes dans la forêt, il tomba en extase devant sa propre voix et mourut. Apollon, dieu de la Poésie et de la Musique, le transforma alors en la fleur que l'on connaît aujourd'hui. 

Le bouton d'or parvint en Amérique avec les conquérants du Nouveau Monde. Il y gagna au passage un nouveau surnom, "yeux de coyote", faisant écho à une belle légende qui explique l'éclat jaune des prunelles de l'animal : les yeux crevés par un aigle, un coyote les recouvra sous forme de pétales de bouton d'or.

Extrait du "Petit livre du langage des fleurs", Nathalie Chahine, édition Chêne

Hai, MedForians!

Siapkan diri kamu karena panggung kompetisi kasta tertinggi Mobile Legends di tanah air kembali bergulir! MPL Indonesia Season 17 resmi memulai babak Regular Season pada 27 Maret hingga 24 Mei 2026. 

Musim ini membawa ekspektasi besar setelah kesuksesan M7 World Championship yang mencatatkan sejarah sebagai turnamen mobile esports dengan penonton terbanyak di dunia.

Ada yang berbeda di musim ini. Untuk pertama kalinya, MPL Indonesia akan menyuguhkan Opening Ceremony Regular Season yang dipersembahkan oleh Infinix. Acara ini memadukan kemegahan esports dengan ekspresi kreatif budaya lokal, membuktikan bahwa liga ini bukan sekadar kompetisi, melainkan identitas bangsa.

Persaingan juga dipastikan semakin panas dengan hadirnya gelar baru "KINGFINIX" dari Infinix bagi sang juara. Dukungan penuh dari pemerintah dan berbagai pihak melalui PBESI pun memperkokoh posisi MLBB sebagai olahraga nasional yang menggerakkan ekonomi kreatif.

Menjelang satu dekade perjalanan Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, Season 17 menjadi bukti pertumbuhan ekosistem esports Indonesia yang kian matang. Sembilan tim terbaik siap bertarung demi membuktikan siapa yang layak menyandang gelar raja musim ini.

Genau ein Jahr lang sind wir jetzt in Repelen, Meerbeck, Utfort, Rheinkamp und Eick Ost/West unterwegs und helfen Menschen mit Unterstützungsbedarf ihren Alltag zu meistern. Die Freude über diesen besonderen Geburtstag haben wir von der Diakoniestation Repelen gestern auf superschöne Weise mit euch, unseren Patientinnen, Angehörigen, Nachbarinnen und allen Interessierten, teilen dürfen - Beim Open House hier bei uns in der Elisabeth Selbert Straße.

Was uns besonders freut: Unsere Besuchenden haben den Tag mit uns ganz offenbar genossen - nach der guten Laune zu urteilen 😉 😊. Ob beim Kurzcheck-up mit Blutdruckmessen, mit Stift und Kleber beim kreativen Gestalten bunter Schutzengel*innen oder beim entspannten Zusammensitzen in der Sonne mit frischen Waffeln.

Danke an alle, die diesen Tag mit uns geteilt haben! Für die Begegnungen, Gespräche und das große Interesse an unserer Arbeit! 💙

キューカルアトリエさんにて

4月25日（土）～5月31日（日）
@9_atelier 

長野では初めての個展です。
お取り扱いいただくようになって2年ほどになりますが、
飛行船、壁飾り、時計などたくさんの方にお選びいただきました。
こういった不思議な作品だけど
軽井沢っていう土地が作風に合うのか
反響があって嬉しいです。
飛行船や壁飾りなどをメインとして展示したいです。

カフェ＆ギャラリー温々さんにて

4月28日（火）～5月10日（日）

その前にもグループ展でお世話になっているので10年近くの付き合いになるのでしょうか。
昼はとても混んで賑やか。
夜は少し静かになって、森のカフェ。
時間帯で纏う空気が変わる良い空間です。
せっかくだからカトラリーも展示したいな。
こちらも楽しみ。

ほぼ同時期なので少し準備が大変です。
それでも春、初夏の心地良い季節に展示ができるのは毎年の楽しみです。

The Cambridge Mobile Telematics round is the most instructive deal of March 31. Allianz X leading a $350 million round in an AI telematics company is not a venture capital bet. It is a strategic infrastructure investment by an insurer that understands usage-based insurance is the next structural shift in automotive coverage. 

The traditional actuarial model — age, zip code, vehicle type, claims history — is a proxy for driving behavior. AI telematics provides the actual driving behavior data directly. 

Every insurer that fails to integrate telematics into its underwriting model will eventually be adversely selected against by competitors who do. Allianz is ensuring it is not in that position.
